8242123.en: Even if I do make you angry, I will not let you do such a foolish thing. Promise me that you will never have such dangerous thoughts again.
8242123.ch: 即便气你，我也不会让你做出这般傻事，除非你答应我，绝不再有此危险的想法。

8242124.en: I cannot just leave when this has to do with your life. Promise me that you will never have such dangerous thoughts again.
8242124.ch: 性命相关之事，我做不到这样便离开，除非你答应我，绝不再有此危险的想法。

8242125.en: Y-You're making me so mad! Fine! I won't do this anymore! Happy now?
8242125.ch: 你，你气死我！好，我便不做此事了，你满意了吗？

8242126.en: You...! Whatever, I give up on this. Satisfied?
8242126.ch: 你！罢了，我放弃做此事了，你满意了吗？

8242129.en: Once I go, you won't see me again. Are you sure?
8242129.ch: 此去一别，不见何时再见，你决定？

8242131.en: W-Why are you suddenly saying this?

8242132.en: R-Really? I thought you'd never love me again in your life...
8242132.ch: 真，真的吗？我以为你这辈子，你都不会再喜欢我了……

8242133.en: Uhn... So you're willing to be my Partner again?
8242133.ch: 嗯……那你愿意再和我结为道侣吗？

8242135.en: I shouldn't have said yes so quickly. You men always fail to appreciate what you get easily.
8242135.ch: 我本不应该这么快答应你，你们男人对于太容易得到的东西，总是不懂得珍惜。

8242136.en: I know I'll return to your side with one line from you. It seems as though I think too lightly of myself.
8242136.ch: 我知道，你的一句话，我就回到你身边，似有些看低了自己。

8242137.en: But I can't help it. I like you so much... As long as you tell me it's possible, I will be reckless, like a moth to a flame.
8242137.ch: 但我忍不住，我就是这般喜欢你，只要你给我一个可能，我便会奋不顾身，飞蛾扑火。

8242138.en: I have only one request, and it's for you to never leave me behind again...
8242138.ch: 我唯一有个要求，就是你能不能别再丢下我了……

8242139.en: I won't leave you behind again.

8242140.en: Thank you, but I don't need it. You can save your concern for someone else.
8242140.ch: 谢谢，但我不需要，你的担心还是留给别人吧……

8242142.en: I won't do anything foolish, don't worry.
8242142.ch: 我不会再做傻事的，你可以放心。

8242144.en: I hope that you can let it go soon and meet the right person...
8242144.ch: 希望你能早日放下，遇到合适的人……

8242145.en: Whether I let go or not has nothing to do with you anymore. There's no need for you to sympathize.
8242145.ch: 我放下不放下，与你都无关了，用不着你这般惺惺作态。

8242147.en: You're right. We don't have anything to do with each other anymore...
8242147.ch: 你说得对，我们确实已经没关系了……

8242148.en: You slowly turn around and leave in sadness.
8242148.ch: 你缓缓转身，黯然的离开了

8242149.en: {name|A}, I hope I won't meet you again in my next life...
8242149.ch: {name|A}，希望下辈子，我不会再遇到你了……

8242150.en: In the bustling town, people are hustling. Many people are gathered in the doorway of the Immortal Wardrobe. You walk closer and see that the Partners you know are arguing.
8242150.ch: 喧闹的城镇中，人潮涌动，在仙衣阁门口，更是围了许多人，你走近一看，竟是自己的两位道侣在争吵。

8242151.en: {name|B}, {name|A} is also your Partner. Are you upsetting the peace over an outfit?
8242151.ch: {name|B}，{name|A}也是你的道侣，莫不是因为一件衣服便伤了和气？

8242152.en: {name|C}, {name|A} love me most. If {gender|A} were here, you will be told to give this outfit to me.
8242152.ch: {name|C}，{name|A}最爱我了，若{gender|A}在此处，必定会让你把这件衣服让与我。

8242153.en: What a joke! {name|A} obviously loves me more, and will make you give me the outfit!
8242153.ch: 笑话，{name|A}明明更爱我，肯定会让你把衣服给我！

8242155.en: What are you thinking? {name|A} obviously loves me more!
8242155.ch: 你想什么呢，{name|A}明明更爱我！

8242156.en: Looking at the argument in front of you, you decide to...
8242156.ch: 看着眼前的争吵，你决定？

8242157.en: Ahem... Why are you two arguing in front of an audience?
8242157.ch: 咳咳……你们二人怎在大庭广众之下争吵。

8242158.en: Your voice stops the two from arguing right away, and they look surprised as they hurry to you.
8242158.ch: 你的声音方才响起，两人顿时停下争吵，面露惊喜，赶忙走到你面前。

8242160.en: I was passing through this place on business, and saw you two arguing. What happened?
8242160.ch: 有事路过此地，远远便看到你们在争吵，是何原因？

8242161.en: It's all {name|C}'s fault for not letting me have this one-and-only outfit.
8242161.ch: 还不是{name|C}，不肯将唯一的这件衣服让与我，不然我们怎会争吵。

8242162.en: We both saw this at the same time! Why should I let you have it? I want to wear it and show it to {name|A}.
8242162.ch: 明明这衣服是我们同时看中的，凭什么让你，我还想穿给{name|A}看呢。

8242163.en: Hmph! Well, {name|A} is here. Let {gender2|A} tell us who should have the outfit.
8242163.ch: 哼，如今{name|A}在这里，让{gender|A}来说，这件衣服该给谁？

8242164.en: {name|A}, you be the judge. Who should have this outfit?
8242164.ch: {name|A}，你来给我们评评理，这件衣服该给谁？

8242166.en: I knew it. {name|A} has a discerning eye.
8242166.ch: 我就知道，{name|A}你最有眼光了。

8242170.en: I knew it. {name|A} loves me most.

8242173.en: This outfit is not good enough for you all. Go pick something better.
8242173.ch: 这件衣服岂能配得上你们，再去挑选更为好看的吧。

8242174.en: I knew it. {name|A}, you say things like these to deceive us.
8242174.ch: 我就知道，{name|A}你只会说这种话糊弄我们。

8242175.en: That's right, {gender|A} is a master of deceit.
8242175.ch: 没错，说{gender|A}是糊弄大师都不过分。

8242176.en: Let's ignore {gender2|A}. {name|C}, let's go have drinks.

8242177.ch: 不理{gender|A}了，{name|C}我们继续逛街去。

8242178.en: Yeah, let's go. Let {name|A} reflect on themselves.
8242178.ch: 好，我们走，让{name|A}自己一个人反省反省。

8242180.en: Intuition tells you that it will be wise to leave now, so you leave quietly.
8242180.ch: 直觉告诉你，这时候离开方是明智之举，于是你悄悄地离开了。

8242182.en: Cultivator {name|B}, how can I help you?

8242183.en: You were impressive at the Immortal Tournament and won first place. It left a deep impression on me.
8242183.ch: 升仙大会之上，道友力压群雄，夺得第一，让在下可是留下了深刻印象。

8242185.en: You are too humble. I could tell that the last battle did not draw out your full power.
8242185.ch: 道友这就过谦了，在下可是看出，这最后一战恐怕都没能让道友使出全力。

8242186.en: The Immortal Tournament is not a life and death match, so there is no need to over-exert.
8242186.ch: 这升仙大会又不是生死决斗，点到为止就好。

8242188.en: I heard that there is a place nearby with beautiful scenery. I wonder if you would be interested in going over together. It would be even better if you could give me pointers for my cultivation.
8242188.ch: 听闻周围有一处地方风景宜人，不知道友可愿一起去游玩一番，若能指点一下我的修行那就更好了。

8242189.en: Yes. Since I promised you, I will not go back on my word.
8242189.ch: 嗯，既然答应你，便不会食言。

8242190.en: Sorry, I have things to do.

8242191.en: Thank you for your company, {call|B|A}. I have had a great time these past few days...
8242191.ch: 谢谢{call|B|A}的陪伴，这几日我过得很快乐……

8242193.en: I... I have something to say to you.
8242193.ch: 我，我……我有句话想对你说。

8242194.en: What do you want to say?

8242196.en: {name|B} stands in front of you, hesitant, with their face turning redder and redder.
8242196.ch: 只见{name|B}在你面前，迟迟开不了口，脸却变得越来越红。

8242197.en: {name|B} stands in front of you, stammering.
8242197.ch: 只见{name|B}在你面前，支支吾吾起来。

8242198.en: Why is your face so red? Do you feel unwell?
8242198.ch: 你怎么脸红得这般厉害，可是哪里不舒服？

8242199.en: Well, it's best to come out and say it.

8242200.en: Oh, you. Why are you so silly?
8242200.ch: 哎呀，你这人，怎么这么笨呢。

8242201.en: G-Give me a little more time...

8242202.en: {name|B} raises the head in determination, like the mind has been made up, and stares at you with a pair of bright eyes. You see that {gender1|B} eyes hold the stars, the sea... and you.
8242202.ch: {name|B}像下定了决心一般，坚定地抬起头，一双明亮的眼睛注视着你，你看见{gender|B}的眼里藏着星辰大海，还有你。

8242203.en: {name|A}, I like you. I like the domineering you from the Immortal Tournament. I like the you who is willing to accompany me on my travels. I like you, who is standing in front of me right now.
8242203.ch: {name|A}，我喜欢你，喜欢那个在升仙大会上技压群雄的你，喜欢那个愿意陪我游玩的你，喜欢此刻站在我面前的你。

8242205.en: When I spend time with you, the sky is more blue, the wind more refreshing, and the leaves more green. Every bit of scenery I see becomes more charming.
8242205.ch: 和你相处的这些时光，我发觉天特别蓝，风特别清爽，树叶特别绿，所有掠过的风景，都变得特别迷人。

8242206.en: I think this is what it's like to like someone.
8242206.ch: 我想，这就是喜欢一个人的感觉吧。

8242207.en: {name|A}, I like you. Will you be with me?
8242207.ch: {name|A}，我喜欢你，你愿意和我在一起吗？

8242209.en: I'm so happy, {name|A}! I've never been so happy in my life!
8242209.ch: {name|A}，我好开心，这一辈子我从来没有像此刻这般开心过。

8242210.en: {name|A}, I feel like the happiest person in the world right now.
8242210.ch: {name|A}，这一刻我觉得自己就是世间最幸福的人。

8242211.en: I'm sorry, this is just so sudden. I can't accept...
8242211.ch: 抱歉，我一时还无法接受……

8242212.en: The brightness in {name|B}'s eyes dims when you utter the words. {gender1|B} eyes slowly fill with tears as {gender|B} tries not to let them fall.
8242212.ch: 你的话音刚落，{name|B}眼里的光芒便消失了，{gender|B}眼眶渐渐湿润，却一直在努力地不让眼泪落下。

8242213.en: The brightness in {name|B}'s eyes dims when you utter the words. {gender|B} is suddenly at a loss.
8242213.ch: 你的话音刚落，{name|B}眼里的光芒便消失了，{gender|B}在你面前突然手足无措。

8242214.en: It's okay. I like you, but I can't require you to like me too, right?
8242214.ch: 没关系的，我喜欢你，不能要求你也喜欢我，对不对。

8242215.en: Liking you is my own issue. You don't like me, but I will always like you. I won't disturb you.
8242215.ch: 喜欢你是我的事，虽然你不喜欢我，但我会一直喜欢你，不会打扰你的。

8242217.en: Watching {name|B} leave, you feel a twang of an unknown emotion n your heart.
8242217.ch: 看着{name|B}离去的背影，你心中出现了一丝莫名的情绪。

8242218.en: You walk out from the Auction House and turn into a quiet alley. Suddenly, a figure appears in front of you, blocking your way.
8242218.ch: 你从拍卖行之中走出，拐进了一条偏僻的巷子中，突然前方出现一道人影，拦住了你的去路。

8242219.en: You seem like you're in a hurry. Where are you going?
8242219.ch: 道友神色匆匆，这是要去哪呢？

8242220.en: Where I'm going has nothing to do with you. Please move out of the way.
8242220.ch: 我去哪和道友恐怕没有任何关系吧，还请道友让条路。

8242221.en: Let's talk. You just need to give the {getUnitProp|A} that you got from the Auction House to me, and I'll step out of your way. What do you say?
8242221.ch: 好说好说，道友只需把你在拍卖行中所得的{getUnitProp|A}给我，这条路便让与你，如何？

8242222.en: If you do not cease this, I shall rip your face off.
8242222.ch: 道友，你若不识趣，那别怪在下撕破这脸皮了。

8242223.en: Who are you to dare to threaten me?
8242223.ch: 你是什么东西，也敢威胁我。

8242224.en: Since you are so clueless, I'll clue you in to my power today.
8242224.ch: 既然你这般不识趣，今日便让你尝尝我的厉害。

8242225.en: Why fight and kill? I'll let you have it since you want it.
8242225.ch: 打打杀杀多不好，道友既然想要，给你便是。

8242226.en: This {getUnitProp|A} is an item that I acquired at a high price in the Auction House. I hope you keep it safe, Cultivator.
8242226.ch: 这{getUnitProp|A}是我在拍卖行中花了大价格得来之物，望道友收好。

8242227.en: You're sensible. I'll let you off today.
8242227.ch: 算你识相，今日便放过你一马。

8242228.en: I admit my mistake, Cultivator. Here, have this {getUnitProp|B}. Will you let me live?
8242228.ch: 道友，在下知道错了，这{getUnitProp|B}给你，可否放在下一条生路。

8242229.en: Hmph. I'll accept this. I won't let you off so easily if there's a next time.
8242229.ch: 哼，东西我收下了，再有下次就不会这么轻易地放过你了。

8242230.en: Yes, of course, I'll leave right now.

8242231.en: Since you're here, I'll take your life.
8242231.ch: 既然来了，那就把命留下来吧。

8242233.en: Be more aware in the future when you go out into the world. There are people you must not anger.
8242233.ch: 以后出门带上眼睛，别惹到不该惹的人。

8242234.en: Yes, yes, of course, you are absolutely right.

8242235.en: You dare take out this garbage? Be more aware in the future when you go out into the world. There are people you must not anger.
8242235.ch: 这些垃圾也好意思拿出来，以后出门带上眼睛，别惹到不该惹的人。

8242237.en: You know how powerful I am now, right? So, have you figured out what you should do now?
8242237.ch: 现在见识到我的厉害了吧，你想好该怎么做了吗？

8242238.en: I'll give you this {getUnitProp|A}. Please accept it and let me go.
8242238.ch: 这{getUnitProp|A}给你，还请收下后放过我。

8242239.en: You're sensible. You'd better be more accommodating the next time I see you.
8242239.ch: 算你识相，下次再找你，给我主动一点。

8242241.en: I'm taking this {getUnitProp|A} and I'll spare your life this time. Hand over the item obediently the next time I ask you.
8242241.ch: 这{getUnitProp|A}我拿走了，这次便绕你一命，下次再问你，赶紧老实一点交出来。

8242242.en: You are in a hurry when a person suddenly appears and blocks your way.
8242242.ch: 你正在赶路之时，突然出现一人，拦住了你的去路。

8242243.en: Long time no see, {name|A}. Do you remember me?
8242243.ch: {name|A}道友，许久不见，不知道还记得在下不？

8242244.en: It's you... Close to the Auction House...

8242245.en: Ah, you remember me. That pleases me. You know why I came today, right?
8242245.ch: 亏道友还记得在下，真是让人高兴，你可知今日我为何而来？

8242246.en: What, are you here to beg for mercy again?
8242246.ch: 怎么，莫不是又过来求饶的？

8242248.en: You and I had a fight in an alley close to the Auction House a few months ago. Do you remember that?
8242248.ch: 数月前在拍卖行外的巷子中，你我二人曾战斗一场，你可还记得？

8242250.en: I've come to settle an old score today. {name|C} and I have joined forces, and we'll beat you to a pulp.
8242250.ch: 哼，今日便来算一算旧账，我和{name|C}联手，不把你打得满地找牙。

8242251.en: Don't claim that we are bullying you two-on-one. Just blame it on your luck. There has never been real fairness in the world.
8242251.ch: 这位道友，别说我们二打一欺负你，要怪便怪你运气太差，在这八荒之中，从来没有真正的公平。

8242252.en: Hmph! I shall have my revenge! I'll teach you a lesson!
8242252.ch: 哼，昨日之仇今日报，我要好好教训你一番！

8242254.en: I will give you one more chance. It will be embarrassing if you lose still. Get lost.
8242254.ch: 再给你一次机会，还是输，实在丢人现眼，赶紧滚。

8242256.en: I was blind to have dared to confront you! I won't dare to do so in the future.
8242256.ch: 道友，我也是一时被蒙蔽才瞎了眼来对付你，以后再也不敢了。

8242257.en: Since you're here, you can leave without your life. You think you can bully me?
8242257.ch: 既然来了，那就把命留下来吧，真当我好欺负的吗。

8242259.en: I regret listening to {name|B} and acting on their words.
8242259.ch: 悔不该听了这{name|B}的话出手。

8242262.en: I thank you, Cultivator, for not killing me.

8242270.en: You didn't think I would defeat you, huh? I suffered heavy wounds the last time, and the {getUnitProp|A} you have on you is my compensation. Be good and hand over your items the next time I come looking for you.
8242270.ch: 没想过我会打败你吧？上次让我受了这么重的伤，你身上的{getUnitProp|A}便是给我的补偿了，后面再找你，赶紧老实一点交出来。

8242274.en: Haha, you remember me. You know why I came today, right?
8242274.ch: 哈哈，难为道友还记得在下，你可知今日我为何而来？

8242276.en: It's not anything serious. See, I don't have much money these days. Why don't you lend me the {getUnitProp|A}?
8242276.ch: 也不是什么大事，就是在下最近手头不是很宽裕，道友不如借我{getUnitProp|A}？

8242278.en: You gave me stuff a few months ago, close to the Auction House. You can't have forgotten me so quickly.
8242278.ch: 数月前在拍卖行外，道友曾送我东西，不会这么快便忘了吧。

8242280.en: I'm glad you remember. See, I don't have much money these days. Why don't you lend me the {getUnitProp|A}?
8242280.ch: 道友想起来便好，这不，在下最近手头不是很宽裕，道友不如借我{getUnitProp|A}？

8242281.en: This will ruin the peace, Cultivator. Are you sure you've thought it through?
8242281.ch: 道友若这般说，那怕是要伤和气了，你真的考虑好了吗？

8242283.en: Hahaha, nice and brisk. I won't disturb your cultivation then. See you later.
8242283.ch: 哈哈哈，这么爽快多好，那我也不打扰道友修行了，后会有期。

8242284.en: This will just keep happening. I won't give it to you today, no matter what.
8242284.ch: 一而再再而三，何时方是个头，今日无论如何我都不会给你的。

8242285.en: You're just forcing my hand. You asked for it!
8242285.ch: 敬酒不吃吃罚酒，道友休怪我动手了！

8242287.en: Hmph. Get lost. I won't let you off so easily next time.
8242287.ch: 哼，快滚，下次就不会这么轻易地放过你了

8242289.en: It's not about ruining the peace now. I'll take your life!
8242289.ch: 现在就不是伤和气了，给我把命留下来！

8242291.en: Well? Did I ruin the peace?
8242291.ch: 你说，我有没有伤和气呢？

8242292.en: No, no, it was I who ruined the peace. I was wrong... wrong...
8242292.ch: 没有没有，是我伤和气，在下错了……错了。

8242299.en: I'm taking this {getUnitProp|A} from you and I'll spare your life this time. Hand over the item obediently the next time I ask you.
8242299.ch: 你身上的{getUnitProp|A}我拿走了，这次便绕你一命，下次再问你，赶紧老实一点交出来。

8242302.en: Let's cut to the chase. Take out the {getUnitProp|A} right now and hand it to me, or suffer the consequences.
8242302.ch: 废话不多说，现在立刻拿出{getUnitProp|A}给我，否则后果你懂的。

8242304.en: Hmph. Good. You may leave now.
8242304.ch: 哼，算你老实，你可以退下了。

8242305.en: I've had enough. I won't give you anything anymore.
8242305.ch: 我受够了，今日我不会再给你任何东西。

8242306.en: Oh? You dare defy me? I'll teach you a lesson today so you'll remember who's boss.
8242306.ch: 哟，居然敢反抗我了，那今日便教训教训你，让你长长记性。

8242310.en: You're not leaving this time! Not alive!
8242310.ch: 这次你就别走了，给我把命留下来！

8242323.en: You dare become Partners with my {relation|C|B}? And you even ask me who I am?
8242323.ch: 你敢和我的{relation|C|B}结为道侣，还好意思问我是谁？

8242324.en: So you're the {relation|C|B} of {name|C}. How can I help you?

8242325.en: Sorry, I'm not interested in who you are.
8242325.ch: 抱歉，对于你是谁，我不敢兴趣。

8242328.en: Damn you! How dare you speak to me so flippantly!
8242328.ch: 可恶，你怎么能用这么轻描淡写的语气和我说话！

8242329.en: If you have any business, state it, or I'll leave.

8242330.en: I'll give you three months to break off relations with {name|C}, and I'll pretend it never happened. Or else...
8242330.ch: 给你三个月时间，和{name|C}彻底断绝关系，我便当做没发生过这一切，否则……

8242331.en: As soon as the words leave your mouth, {name|B} smacks a stone next to you. That stone shatters, pulverized.
8242331.ch: 你的话语刚落，{name|B}便一掌拍向了旁边的一颗石头，只见那颗石头顿时碎成了粉末。

8242332.en: You'll end up like this stone.
8242332.ch: 这颗石头，便是你的下场。

8242334.en: Are you afraid now? I am not a murderous person, and I understand that young people make mistakes. I hope you can correct your mistake.
8242334.ch: 知道害怕了吧？我非嗜杀之人，年轻人犯错我也理解，望你知错能改。

8242336.en: Okay, no need to explain. I've made it clear to you, so think over it carefully.
8242336.ch: 好了，不用解释了，话我已经说得够明白了，你好好考虑清楚吧。

8242337.en: {name|B} gives you no chance to respond, and disappears.
8242337.ch: {name|B}说完，不给你任何开口机会，便消失了。

8242338.en: {name|A}, how dare you take my words for granted and get entangled with my {relation|C|B} {name|C}!
8242338.ch: {name|A}，你竟然把我的话当耳旁风，还敢和我的{relation|C|B}{name|C}纠缠在一起！

8242339.en: My relationship with {name|C} is not for you to meddle in.
8242339.ch: 我和{name|C}之间的关系，还轮不到你指手画脚。

8242340.en: If that's the case, then let our steel do the talking!
8242340.ch: 既然如此，那便手底下见真章吧！

8242341.en: Cultivator, {name|C} will be very sad if you kill me. Here, have this {getUnitProp|B}. Will you let me live?
8242341.ch: 道友，你若杀死我，{name|C}会很伤心的，这{getUnitProp|B}给你，可否放在下一条生路。

8242346.en: You are not worthy of {name|C} when you're at this level.
8242346.ch: 就这水平，你如何配得上{name|C}

8242347.en: Yes, you're right! I am not worthy of {name|C}!
8242347.ch: 是是是，你说得对，我配不上{name|C}

8242348.en: Get lost. I wouldn't let you off so easily if I weren't afraid {name|C} would be sad.
8242348.ch: 滚，若不是怕{name|C}伤心，我不会这么轻易放过你。

8242349.en: Yes, yes, of course... I won't dare to do this anymore.
8242349.ch: 是是是……在下以后再也不敢了

8242352.en: I'll accept this {getUnitProp|A}. Break off the relationship with {name|C} immediately.
8242352.ch: 这{getUnitProp|A}我便收下了，现在立刻和{name|C}解除关系。

8242355.en: Leave. I am not a murderous person, but your relation with {name|C}... I will break it off for you and {name|C}. If you dare harass {gender1|C} again, I will kill you.
8242355.ch: 你走吧，我非嗜杀之人，但你和{name|C}的关系，我便替{name|C}和你断绝了，你敢再缠{gender|C}，下次必杀你。

8242357.en: {name|A}, you can end your relationship with {name|C}. Learn from your mistakes and change, and you will be a better person in the future.
8242357.ch: {name|A}，你能和{name|C}结束关系，知错就改，未来必成大器。

8242359.en: You just have to be strong enough, and you won't have to worry about having a Partner. Here, take this {getUnitProp|B}. Consider it a form of compensation.
8242359.ch: 只要你足够强，还愁没有道侣吗，这{getUnitProp|B}给你，算是我给的补偿。

8242360.en: This {getUnitProp|B} is just what I needed. Thank you.

8242361.en: Haha! How quick. I like you more and more!
8242361.ch: 哈哈，爽快，我越来越欣赏你了。

8242362.en: This {getUnitProp|B} is nice, but I don't need it.

8242364.en: You see a woman crying in the pavilion ahead. You go over to take a look and find that it is {name|C}.
8242364.ch: 你看到前方凉亭有一女子在哭泣，你过去一看，发现竟是{name|C}。

8242365.en: {name|C}, why are you here, and why are you crying?

8242366.en: I don't know what's with that {name|B}, suddenly wanting to cancel our spousal relationship. Perhaps this result for the best. My marriage with {gender2|B} was a mistake, but {gender|B} even tried to hit me...
8242366.ch: 那{name|B}不知怎么了，突然要和我解除夫妻关系，若是这般结束也好，我和{gender|B}的婚姻本就是一桩错误，但{gender|B}竟然妄图打我……

8242370.en: {name|B} is not open-minded, and I'm afraid {gender|B} will still harass me.
8242370.ch: 那{name|B}不是个心胸开阔之人，我怕{gender|B}还会对我纠缠不清。

8242371.en: As soon as the words are spoken, {name|B}'s voice comes from behind.
8242371.ch: 话音刚落，{name|B}的声音便从背后传了过来。

8242372.en: What are the two of you doing here? {name|C}, we've only just broken up and you're already in such a hurry?
8242372.ch: 你们二人在这干嘛？{name|C}，我们才分开，你便这般迫不及待了吗？

8242373.en: What a joke. What does it matter to you whether I'm in a hurry or not?
8242373.ch: 笑话，我便是迫不及待，又和你有什么关系？

8242374.en: Don't provoke me! {name|C}, you should have reflected on your actions enough over the past few days. I'll be generous and give you another chance to come back to me.
8242374.ch: 你，不要尝试激怒我！{name|C}，想必这些日子你一个人反思够了吧，我宽宏大量再给你一个机会，回到我身边。

8242375.en: Give up. I will never go back to you.
8242375.ch: 你死心吧，我不会再回到你身边的。

8242376.en: {name|B} gives you a glare, and a strong killing intent locks on to you.
8242376.ch: {name|B}深深看了你一眼，一道强烈的杀意锁定了你。

8242378.en: It has nothing to do with {name|A}. I've had enough of you!
8242378.ch: 和{name|A}没关系，我只是受够你了！

8242379.en: I'm great! Why don't you love me?! It must be {name|A}'s fault!
8242379.ch: 我这么好，你怎么可能不爱我，一定是{name|A}捣鬼。

8242380.en: {name|A}, be smart and get lost. This is between us husband and wife. You're not involved.
8242380.ch: {name|A}，识相一点就给我滚，这是我们夫妻之间的事，你少掺和。

8242383.en: {name|C}'s gaze is filled with disappointment as they watch you leave.
8242383.ch: 看着你离开，{name|C}眼神中充满了失望。

8242384.en: Leave now, or I won't show any mercy.
8242384.ch: 立刻走，否则休怪我手下无情。

8242386.en: Hmph. You don't know your place. I'll take your life today.
8242386.ch: 哼，不识抬举，今日你便把命留在这里吧。

8242387.en: You decide, {name|C}. Do I kill {name|B} or let {name|B} go?

8242388.en: {name|C}, let me off, for the sake of our years together.
8242388.ch: {name|C}，看着我们这么多年感情的份上，放我一马吧。

8242389.en: This person is petty, and I will regret not killing him.
8242389.ch: 此人心胸狭隘，不杀恐后悔无穷。

8242390.en: I'd like to kill him, but I'm afraid it will bring you trouble.
8242390.ch: 我想杀，但我怕会给你带来麻烦。

8242392.en: Aaah...! I won't let you off, even if I become a ghost!
8242392.ch: 啊啊啊……我做鬼都不会放过你们的。

8242393.en: You have a point. I'll let this person off today.
8242393.ch: 你说得有理，今日便放过此人一马。

8242394.en: Thank you for not killing me, Cultivator. This {getUnitProp|B} is my most prized possession. Please accept it.
8242394.ch: 感谢道友不杀之恩,这{getUnitProp|B}是我最珍贵之物，还望道友收下。

8242397.en: You have the gall to take out this garbage? Get out of my sight.
8242397.ch: 这些垃圾也好意思拿出来，赶紧有多远滚多远。

8242401.en: You're sensible, at least. Harass {name|C} again and I won't be so merciful.
8242401.ch: 算你识相，再敢纠缠{name|C}，我就没那么好说话了。

8242403.en: I'll take this {getUnitProp|A} from you and spare your life this time. Harass {name|C} again and I won't be so merciful.
8242403.ch: 你身上的{getUnitProp|A}我便拿走了，这次便绕你一命，下次还敢纠缠{name|C}，你就没那么好运气了。

8242404.en: You hear the sounds of a man and woman arguing from afar.
8242404.ch: 你远远便听到了男女之间的争吵声。

8242405.en: {name|C}, you're actually proposing to break off our spousal relationship?!
8242405.ch: {name|C}，你竟然敢提出解除夫妻关系？

8242406.en: Our feelings for each other have long disappeared over the years. We are just spouses in name. Do you think I am unaware of what you do outside?
8242406.ch: 这些年我们之间早就没了感情，表面夫妻罢了，莫不是以为我不知道你在外面做的那些事？

8242408.en: Some things are best left unspoken. Let's both retain our dignity and part on good terms.
8242408.ch: 有些话就不说破了，彼此保留一些体面，好聚好散吧。

8242409.en: *sneer* You want a good beginning and ending?

8242410.en: Why are you laughing like that? It's scary...
8242410.ch: 你干嘛发出这种笑声，好可怕……

8242411.en: {name|B} tosses out a rune, trapping {name|C} in place.
8242411.ch: 只见{name|B}甩出一道符文，将{name|C}困在原地。

8242412.en: You want a good beginning and ending? I'll give it to you. Stay by my side your whole life and serve me day and night.
8242412.ch: 你想好聚好散，那我便成全你，一辈子都在我的身边，日日夜夜伺候我吧。

8242413.en: Have you gone mad, {name|B}? How can you do this to me?!

8242414.en: {name|C} is about to be taken away. What do you do?

8242415.en: {name|B}, let {name|C} go. I don't mind defeating you again, and I won't let you off easily this time.
8242415.ch: {name|B}，放开{name|C}，我不介意再打败你一次，这次我可不会放过你了。

8242418.en: Release your control over {name|C} in three seconds, and get out of my sight.
8242418.ch: 三息之内，解开{name|C}身上的禁制，滚出我的视线。

8242419.en: I'll leave right away, right now.

8242420.en: {name|B} quickly removes the runes from {name|C} and makes to leave.
8242420.ch: {name|B}迅速解开{name|C}身上的符文，正欲离开。

8242421.en: If I see you harassing {name|C} again, your life is forfeit.
8242421.ch: 如果我再看到你纠缠{name|C}，你这条命就不用要了。

8242422.en: I wouldn't dare! I won't harass {name|C} ever again.
8242422.ch: 不敢了不敢了，我再也不会纠缠{name|C}了。

8242423.en: When {name|B} is far away, you turn and see {name|C} looking at you with tear-filled eyes.
8242423.ch: 待{name|B}走远后，你一转头，看到{name|C}正双目含泪地看着你。

8242424.en: I thought I was going to fall into {name|B}'s evil clutches and lose my freedom, never to see you again...
8242424.ch: 我差点以为就要陷入{name|B}的魔爪，从此失去自由，再也见不到你……

8242425.en: I was fortunate you appeared, or else... I really wouldn't know what to do...
8242425.ch: 幸好你出现了，否则，我真不知该怎么办……

8242426.en: {name|C} leans on your shoulder and starts sobbing.
8242426.ch: 话音落完，{name|C}便靠在你的肩膀上抽泣起来。

8242428.en: How dare you do something like this to {name|C}! I'll teach you a lesson today.
8242428.ch: 你竟然敢对{name|C}做出这种事，今日我便教训你一顿。

8242429.en: Cultivator, I won't dare to harass {name|C} ever again. Here, have this {getUnitProp|B}. Will you let me live?
8242429.ch: 道友，我再也不敢纠缠{name|C}了，这{getUnitProp|B}给你，可否放在下一条生路。

8242432.en: You will have to die, for {name|C}'s sake.

8242434.en: You dare harass {name|C} with this level of strength? Trash!
8242434.ch: 这等实力还敢纠缠{name|C}，废物！

8242435.ch: 是是是，你说得对，我就是个废物！

8242436.en: Get lost. Appear before me again and you won't walk away alive.
8242436.ch: 滚，再出现在我面前，就不会让你活着离开了。

8242437.en: Yes, yes... I'll never appear in front of you ever again.
8242437.ch: 是是是……在下以后绝不出现在你眼前。

8242438.en: Well? You wanted to teach me a lesson. How have you lost so badly?
8242438.ch: 怎么啦？不是要教训我，现在怎么输得这么惨

8242440.en: I'll accept this {getUnitProp|A}. Don't harass {name|C} ever again.
8242440.ch: 这{getUnitProp|A}我便收下了，别再纠缠{name|C}了。

8242442.en: Leave. I am not a murderous person. I've taken the {getUnitProp|A} from you as compensation. You won't be as fortunate next time if you dare harass {name|C} again.
8242442.ch: 你走吧，我非嗜杀之人，你身上的{getUnitProp|A}便是给我的补偿了，你再敢纠缠{name|C}，下次就没这么好运。

8242443.en: You turn to leave. {name|B} looks in the direction your left and smiles disdainfully.
8242443.ch: 你转身离开，{name|B}看着你离开的方向，不屑地一笑。

8242446.en: I can see that you are exceptionally talented, and will definitely become a great person in the future.
8242446.ch: 我观道友天赋非凡，未来必成大器。

8242447.en: And what does that have to do with you?

8242448.en: I learned a bit of reading Destiny when I was young, and I can see that Cultivator {name|A} is bound for good fortune.
8242448.ch: 在下早年学得一点看气运的本事，看得出，{name|A}道友必定是福缘深厚之人。

8242450.en: I'd like to follow you, Cultivator, and help you Transcend as soon as possible.
8242450.ch: 我欲追随道友，助道友早日登仙。

8242452.en: I just hope to be blessed by a smidgen of fortune while following you.
8242452.ch: 在下希望在追随道友的过程中，沾到一丝福缘就满足了。

8242453.en: I will also do my best to help you in your cultivation.
8242453.ch: 我也会尽全力助道友修行。

8242454.en: You are a truthful person, so let's give it a try.
8242454.ch: 你这人说话算实诚，那便试试吧。

8242455.en: That's wonderful! If you don't mind, I would like to Bond with you.
8242455.ch: 那实在太好了，若道友不嫌弃，在下愿与道友结义。

8242456.en: {call|B|A}, this {getUnitProp|B} is a gift. I hope {call|B|A} will not refuse it.
8242456.ch: 见过{call|B|A}，这{getUnitProp|B}便送给你，希望{call|B|A}莫要推辞。

8242458.en: I'm used to being alone. Do you understand?
8242458.ch: 我独来独往惯了，你明白吗？

8242459.en: I do, I understand. I won't bother you then, Cultivator. Goodbye.
8242459.ch: 我懂我懂，那在下便不打扰道友了，告辞。

8242460.en: I heard {call|B|A} has learned a new Martial Art. I have come to congratulate you.
8242460.ch: 听闻{call|B|A}你学了新功法，在下特地前来祝贺。

8242461.en: This {0} is a gift for {call|B|A}. I wish {call|B|A} great success in reaching VIII in Martial Arts soon.
8242461.ch: 这{0}便赠与{call|B|A}，愿{call|B|A}功法早日大成。

8242462.en: I heard of {call|B|A}'s wedding, and specially hurried over to wish you a long and happy marriage.
8242462.ch: 听闻{call|B|A}大婚，我特地赶过来，祝你新婚快乐，百年好合。

8242464.en: I have a {getUnitProp|B} for your wife. Please pass it on, {call|B|A}. This is but a token, and I hope you accept it.
8242464.ch: 我这有{getUnitProp|B}送给尊夫人，便由{call|B|A}转交了，一点点心意，希望不要嫌弃。

8242466.en: {call|B|A}, I heard you've been hurt. Is it serious?

8242468.en: Take this {0} to heal your wounds quickly.

8242469.en: {call|B|A} is going to the {currentArea|A} to train?

8242471.en: {call|B|A}, you are going to a dangerous place. Take this {0} and be careful.
8242471.ch: {call|B|A}你去这等危险之地，这{0}你拿着，望一切小心。

8242472.en: {call|B|A}, would you like me to assist in dealing with the enemy?

8242473.en: Just in time. You and I will fight this person today.
8242473.ch: 来得刚好，今日你我便一起对抗此人。

8242474.ch: 你们真不要脸，居然二打一。

8242475.en: No matter. Just myself is enough.

8242477.en: {call|B|A}, are you going to the Auction House to look for items you admire?
8242477.ch: {call|B|A}可是要到拍卖行寻找心仪之物？

8242479.en: I have {getUnitProp|B}. Take them all, {call|B|A}. It would be bad if you miss out on your treasures because of a lack of Spirit Stones.
8242479.ch: 我身上有{getUnitProp|B}，{call|B|A}你全部拿去吧，若因为灵石不足而错失宝物可太不划算了。

8242481.en: I am satisfied with these words from you, {call|B|A}. Here, take these Spirit Stones!
8242481.ch: 有{call|B|A}你这句话我便满足了，这些灵石你快拿去吧！

8242482.en: There's no need for so much. Keep some for yourself.
8242482.ch: 不用这么多，你也留一些自己用。

8242483.en: You're such a good person {call|B|A}, to be so thoughtful. Please take half.
8242483.ch: {call|B|A}你真好，还帮我想着，那这一半你便拿去吧。

8242484.en: I appreciate the thought, but I have enough Spirit Stones, so you can put them away.
8242484.ch: 你的心意我心领了，但我身上灵石够，你先收起来吧。

8242485.en: Since {call|B|A} says so, I am relieved.
8242485.ch: 既然{call|B|A}这样说，我也放心了。

8242486.en: You hear an explosion, and discover two Soul Formation Cultivators fighting each other in the air above the forest nearby.
8242486.ch: 一道爆炸声传来，你发现不远处的树林上空有两位化神修士正隔空对峙。

8242487.en: {name|C}, let's end all our old grudges and new feuds today.
8242487.ch: {name|C}，新仇旧怨，今日便一次性了结吧。

8242488.en: Hmph! I've wanted to fight you for a long while. Only one of us will live at the end of today.
8242488.ch: 哼，我也早就想与你一战了，今日不是你死便是我亡。

8242489.en: The wind rises abruptly. The sky and the earth change color, and the Soul Formation battle begins.
8242489.ch: 狂风骤起，天地变色，化神之战一触即发。

8242491.en: Haha! You were unbeatable to me in the past, but you're now at my feet, defeated!
8242491.ch: 哈哈，当年你在我面前是那么的不可一世，如今还不是败在我脚下了！

8242492.en: Kill me if you want. Stop with the nonsense.

8242493.en: You're asking me to kill you? I won't!

8242494.en: Even the most sacred of doctors won't be able to save a person whose immortal soul has been shattered. I want you to feel the helplessness of watching yourself die without having the power to return to heaven! Hahaha!
8242494.ch: 元魂已碎之人，哪怕医圣出手也救不活了，我要你好好感受，这种看着自己走向死亡，却无力回天的感觉，哈哈哈！

8242495.en: After laughing loudly, {name|C} ascends into the sky, leaving {name|B} on the ground, heavily wounded.
8242495.ch: 一声大笑后，{name|C}御空而去，留下{name|B}重伤盘坐在地上。

8242496.en: Come out, kid. No need to hide.
8242496.ch: 旁边那小子，出来吧，莫藏了。

8242497.en: Is that person talking to me? No, he must be bluffing.
8242497.ch: 难道此人在说我，不对，他一定是在诓我。

8242498.en: You, little {grade|A} kid! My immortal soul has been shattered, but my cultivation did not disappear completely. Don't make me come drag you out myself!
8242498.ch: {grade|A}的小子，虽然我元魂已碎，但修为没完全消失，莫不是要我亲自抓你出来！

8242500.en: Senior, this lowly junior means no malice...

8242501.en: I know, and {gender|C} knows too. We are {grade|B} Cultivators after all. You are but a {grade|A} Cultivator. We sensed it when you got close.
8242501.ch: 我知道，{gender|C}也知道，我们好歹是{grade|B}修士，你区区{grade|A}，刚靠近的时候我们便察觉了。

8242503.en: Those under {grade|B} are forever ants. Would you care about an ant?
8242503.ch: 不到{grade|B}，终是蝼蚁，如果是你，你会在意蝼蚁吗？

8242505.en: Ahem. I called you out to offer you an opportunity.
8242505.ch: 咳咳，我叫你出来，便是有一份机缘给你。

8242506.en: May I ask you Seniors what this opportunity is?

8242507.en: Though my Soul has been shattered, I still have a lot of cultivation remaining. If I transfer it to you, it will allow you to attain Breakthrough to {gradeV|1|A} immediately. There are no after-effects, and it will not affect your future cultivation. Will you accept this offer?
8242507.ch: 虽说我元魂已碎，但修为还残存不少，若传给你，可让你直接突破到{gradeV|1|A}，并且没有任何后遗症，不影响你未来的修行，你可愿意接受？

8242508.en: Senior, this humble Junior knows that there is nothing that comes free in this world.
8242508.ch: 前辈，晚辈知道一句话，叫天下没有免费的午餐。

8242509.en: You knew quite a bit, kid. That's right, I have a requirement. If your cultivation has a breakthrough to Soul Formation, you will kill that {name|C} once for me.
8242509.ch: 你小子倒懂得不少，不错，我有一个要求，便是他日若你修为突破化神，便为我去杀那{name|C}一次。

8242510.en: Senior, even if I promise you this now, how will you be sure that I keep this promise?
8242510.ch: 前辈，纵然我现在答应你，你又怎能保证死之后我践行此诺言呢。

8242511.en: Simple. If you agree, you make a vow. If you cannot kill {name|C} once for me, you will not be able to attain Breakthrough to Enlightenment for the rest of your life.
8242511.ch: 这简单，你若答应，便立下一个誓言，若不能为我杀一次{name|C}，便终生无法突破到悟道。

8242512.en: What if that person has reached Breakthrough to Enlightenment? How do I kill {gender2|C} once I get to Soul Formation? Won't I be stuck at Soul Formation forever?
8242512.ch: 若那人突破到了悟道呢，我一化神如何杀{gender|C}，那我岂不是永远停在化神了。

8242513.en: Don't worry, that person will not be able to reach Breakthrough to Enlightenment for a year. Hehe, did you think {gender|C} would not have to pay a price for killing me, {name|B}?
8242513.ch: 放心，一百年内他突破不到悟道，呵呵，你以为{gender|C}杀我{name|B}便不用付出任何代价吗。

8242514.ch: 不愧是前辈，让在下佩服……

8242515.en: I was still defeated in the end. I can only delay {gender2|C} for a time. So, have you thought about it? Are you willing to inherit my Tradition?
8242515.ch: 终究还是败了，我也只能拖{gender|C}一时罢了，如何，你考虑好了吗，可愿接我传承？

8242516.en: I am willing to inherit your Tradition, Senior.

8242517.en: Then make this vow to heaven and earth.
8242517.ch: 那你便立下这天地誓言吧。

8242518.en: Should I receive the Tradition of Senior {name|B}'s cultivation, I will kill {name|C} one time with my own hands, or not attain Enlightenment for my entire life.
8242518.ch: 若我得到前辈{name|B}的修为传承，便亲手杀一次{name|C}，否则终生不得悟道。

8242519.en: I don't have much time left. Let's begin now.
8242519.ch: 我剩下时间不多了，现在就开始吧。

8242520.en: Cough... Good. I didn't expect it to go so well.
8242520.ch: 咳咳，很好，没想到会这么顺利。

8242522.en: Senior, eh? Cough... We have not known each other for a long time, but you are a part of my Tradition. Would you be willing to call me Master?
8242522.ch: 前辈吗……咳咳，你我虽认识不久，但你也算得了我一份传承，不知你可愿称我一声师父？

8242523.en: Esteemed Master, your Apprentice {name|A} greets you.
8242523.ch: 师父在上，请受徒弟{name|A}一拜。

8242524.en: Haha, I have been blessed by the Heavens. I am still able to have an Apprentice before my death to send me off on my final journey. This life has been well lived, well lived indeed...
8242524.ch: 哈哈，老天待我不亏，临死前还能有徒弟来送我最后一程，这辈子也算值了，值了啊……

8242525.en: Right after speaking, {name|B}'s body lost life. You choose a place for your Master's grave for eternal rest, and kowtow to the grave three times.
8242525.ch: 只见话音刚落，{name|B}的身体便断绝了生机，你选择了一处地方，将其好生安葬，在坟前磕了三响。

8242526.en: Next, you must work hard to cultivate to Soul Formation and avenge your Master.
8242526.ch: 接下来，便要努力修炼到化神，为师父报仇。

8242527.en: I do not want to take on a Master yet.

8242528.en: Oh well, I'm going to die after all, so I can't ask for so much.
8242528.ch: 罢了，本就将死之人，不能要求这么多。

8242529.en: Right after speaking, {name|B}'s body lost life. You choose a place for the person's eternal rest.
8242529.ch: 只见话音刚落，{name|B}的身体便断绝了生机，你选择了一处地方，将其好生安葬。

8242530.en: Next, you must work hard to cultivate to Soul Formation and complete the vow.
8242530.ch: 接下来，便要努力修炼到化神，趁早完成誓言。

8242531.en: It is not that I have no intention of accepting your Tradition, Senior.
8242531.ch: 在下还是无意接受前辈的传承

8242532.en: Never mind if it's not fated. There is no forcing it, no forcing it at all...
8242532.ch: 无缘罢了，不可强求，不可强求啊……

8242533.en: Right after speaking, {name|B}'s body blurs and finally dissipates between heaven and earth.
8242533.ch: 伴随着{name|B}的话音落下，他的身体开始虚化，最后彻底消散于天地间。

8242534.en: You have done well, my disciple. You Finally killed this person for your Master.
8242534.ch: 徒儿，你做得很好，终于帮为师杀了此人。

8242536.en: Do not be alarmed. I am long dead, and this is just a spot of consciousness that I deposited on {name|C}. I am only awakened with {name|C} is killed.
8242536.ch: 莫惊讶，我早死了，这不过是我寄存在{name|C}身上的一缕意识，只有{name|C}被杀死的时候，我才会被唤醒。

8242538.en: As your Master, I have not taught you even a day, but you were able to grow so quickly. I am proud.
8242538.ch: 我这个做师父的，没有教过你一天，你能成长得这么快，为师很欣慰。

8242539.en: I would not have been able to reach {grade|A} so quickly without the Tradition from Master back then.
8242539.ch: 若不是师父当年的传承，徒儿也不会这么快便到{grade|A}。

8242540.en: With that way of thinking, I can be assured of leaving those things to you.
8242540.ch: 你能这般想，我也放心将那些东西交给你了。

8242542.en: There is a hidden mountain cave where I have collected materials and prepared Martial Arts for Enlightenment. I leave them all to you.
8242542.ch: 我在一处隐蔽的山洞里，里面放着一些我当年收集的材料和为悟道期准备的功法，便留给你了。

8242544.en: I had just stepped on the path of cultivation back then, and thought that I could find a place isolated from the world to dedicate myself to gaining insight into the world, with the fresh breeze on my back and cool moonlight on my face, far away from the troubles of worldly life.
8242544.ch: 我当年踏入修仙之路，本以为能寻一处与世隔绝之地，从此一心感悟天地大道，清风朗月，远离这令人烦恼的世俗纷争。

8242545.en: In the end, I found that the Immortal World is no different from the mortal world, full of deceit and intrigue. There are always fights to be fought against people, monsters, and the heavens!
8242545.ch: 到头才发现，这修仙世界和那凡俗人间也没什么区别，到处充满着尔虞我诈，阴谋诡计，我时时刻刻都在与人争，与妖争，与天争！

8242546.en: If you do not fight, your fate will always be in the hands of others.
8242546.ch: 若你不争，自己的命运便永远掌握在别人手里。

8242548.en: Yes, Master. Your disciple is here.

8242549.en: My consciousness is about to disappear completely, and I do not have much time to speak. I hope that you reach XII soon, and remove yourself from this game of chess to truly have your fate in your own hands.
8242549.ch: 为师这缕意识要彻底消散了，太多的话没时间说，惟愿你早日修成大道，跳出这方棋局，将命运真正掌握在自己手里。

8242551.en: With a sigh, the space between heaven and earth falls silent. You can sense that the consciousness of your Master has completely dissipated.
8242551.ch: 伴随一身叹息之后，天地之间便彻底安静了下来，你感觉到，师父的意识彻底消散了……

8242556.en: I am this {appellationName|101|B}. I wonder if I may ask to see if your {appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A} cultivation is stronger, or my {appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|B} cultivation.
8242556.ch: 在下是这{appellationName|101|B}，不知可否讨教一番，看看是道友的{appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A}修更强， 还是在下的{appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|B}修更强。

8242558.en: Cultivator, you are strong indeed. I am content with my loss. Your {appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A} cultivation is stronger.
8242558.ch: 道友实力强悍，在下输得心服口服，看来是道友的{appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A}修更强。

8242559.en: You are stronger than me, Cultivator.

8242560.en: Haha, you must have let me win, Cultivator. I will come back again for more pointers.
8242560.ch: 哈哈，道友想必是让我了吧，我还会再来讨教的。

8242561.en: You are {appellationName|101|A}, but don't dare to accept a challenge? What a disappointment.
8242561.ch: 堂堂{appellationName|101|A}，竟然不敢接受挑战，实在令人失望。

8242562.en: Have you heard? That {appellationName|101|B} {name|B} challenged {appellationName|101|A} {name|A}, but {name|A} didn't dare to accept the challenge.
8242562.ch: 听说了吗？那{appellationName|101|B}{name|B}向{appellationName|101|A}{name|A}下战书，那{name|A}居然不敢接受挑战。

8242563.en: Yeah, what an embarrassment to {appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A} cultivation. A mighty Heaven-chosen is actually so spineless. So what if they lose? That's better than not even having the guts to compete. It's not as if it's a life-and-death match either.
8242563.ch: 可不是，真丢{appellationLossVal|101|lossType_1|A}修的脸，堂堂天骄竟然如此没胆，纵然输了又如何，总好过比都不敢比，又不是生死之战。

8242564.en: Keep your voice down. If {name|A} hears, punishing us would be the least of it.
8242564.ch: 小声点，万一被那{name|A}听到，教训我俩还不是绰绰有余。

8242565.en: You're right. Best to be careful with our words.

8242566.en: Have you heard? That {appellationName|101|B} {name|B} challenged {appellationName|101|A} {name|A}, and {name|A} won.
8242566.ch: 听说了吗？那{appellationName|101|B}{name|B}向{appellationName|101|A}{name|A}下战书，最后是{name|A}胜出了。

8242567.en: Have I heard? I was there! {name|A} beat {name|B} like it was a walk in the park. {name|B} could not fight back at all.
8242567.ch: 还用听说？我当时就在现场，{name|A}打{name|B}就跟切菜一般，压得{name|B}毫无反抗之力。

8242569.en: I wonder when we will be able to gain the strength at that level.
8242569.ch: 不知我们何年何月才能拥有此等实力。

8242572.en: Since I was refused by you the last time, I became obsessed and it has affected my cultivation. I hope that you will grant my request and spar with me.
8242572.ch: 自从上次被道友拒绝之后，在下心中始终有着一股执念，影响了修行，希望道友成全，和我切磋一番。

8242576.en: Haha, you must have let me win, Cultivator. I will come again.
8242576.ch: 哈哈，道友想必是让我了吧，我还会再来的。

8242577.en: We Cultivators won't be able to fight against the heavens if we keep retreating and lose our enterprise. Please don't refuse next time.
8242577.ch: 我等修行之人，若一昧退避，少了份进取之心，将来又如何与天争命？望道友下次勿要拒绝我了。

8242580.en: You obviously did not use your full strength to beat me the last time, Cultivator. I want to challenge you again.
8242580.ch: 道友上次胜我，明显是未尽全力，我要再来挑战道友一番

8242584.en: Haha, you did not use your full strength, Cultivator. I will come again.
8242584.ch: 哈哈，道友还是未尽全力啊，我还会再来的。

8242586.en: Let's not waste time on words, {name|A}! Fight me!
8242586.ch: {name|A}道友，废话不多说，来和我一战吧！

8242588.en: This is the true strength of {appellationName|101|A}. I am content, and I will not disturb you again.
8242588.ch: 这才是{appellationName|101|A}的真正实力，在下心服口服，不会再来打扰道友。

8242589.en: You are better than me, Cultivator.
8242589.ch: 道友实在是更胜我一筹。

8242914.en: Then I'll be waiting here for you for three months. Don't forget to come to me!
8242914.ch: 那我便在此地等你三个月哦，别忘了来找我！

8242915.en: It seems we've found Master's cave.
8242915.ch: 看来这便是师父的洞府所在了。

8242916.en: (Here we are at Master's cave finally...)

8242919.en: It seems the contents of that chest are what Master left behind.
8242919.ch: 看来那宝箱中装的，便是师父留下的东西了。

8242922.en: I have a {getUnitProp|B} for your husband. Please pass it on, {call|B|A}. This is but a token, and I hope you accept it.
8242922.ch: 我这有{getUnitProp|B}送给尊夫君，便由{call|B|A}转交了，一点点心意，希望不要嫌弃。

8242925.en: You see a man playing the flute in the pavilion ahead. You go over to take a look and find that it is {name|C}.
8242925.ch: 你看到前方凉亭有一男子在吹笛，你过去一看，发现竟是{name|C}。

8242926.en: {name|C}, why are you here? Why are you playing the flute with such sorrow?
8242926.ch: {name|C}，你怎在此，笛声之中为何充满悲伤。

8242927.en: When {name|B} is far away, you turn and see {name|C} looking at you with affectionate eyes.
8242927.ch: 待{name|B}走远后，你一转头，看到{name|C}正深情地看着你。

8242928.en: I thought {name|B} would capture me and I won't see you ever again.
8242928.ch: 我差点以为就要被{name|B}抓走，再也见不到你了。

8242929.en: With that said, {name|C} holds you in arms.
8242929.ch: 话音落完，{name|C}便把你抱入怀中。

8242930.en: You have just seated yourself in the teahouse when you hear two people discussing at the next table.
8242930.ch: 你路过一家路边的茶馆，方才坐下休息，隔壁桌两人的谈论声便传入你的耳中。

8242932.en: Here's {getUnitProp|B} for you. Please advise me and guide me to help me improve!
8242932.ch: 这{getUnitProp|B}便送给道友，望以后多多指教。

8242936.en: Halfway through your journey, you suddenly sense a pair of eyes watching you from the forest ahead. Suddenly there is a chill around you, and the Nether Air seems much thicker.
8242936.ch: 行至半路，你突然觉得前方枯木林中隐约有一双眼睛在注视着你。霎时间，周围冷风萧瑟，冥气似乎也变得更加浓郁了几分。

8242938.en: (Could this be the color-changing Nether Demon that the Cultivators talk about? Legend has it that this race and humans are mortal enemies. Most of them are aggressive by nature, and are good at running away, they're difficult to kill too. This will be difficult to deal with...)
8242938.ch: （莫非这便是令修仙者谈之色变的冥妖？相传此族类与我人族乃是死敌，其大多生性凶残，还擅长逃跑、难以抹杀，实在是极为难缠……）

8242941.en: Seeing no response from you, the person opposite uses cultivation to send their voice over. The voice is thick, and rumbling, like a tiger's growl.
8242941.ch: 见你毫无反应，对面之人运起深厚修为对你传音而来，其声浑厚苍茫，宛如龙吟虎啸。

8242943.en: The emperor has decreed... evil people... must all be killed...
8242943.ch: 王命有言……恶人……斩尽杀绝……

8242944.en: A tactful one... will be left alive...

8242945.en: The person's figure flickers, and disappears into the withered forest. You glimpse it, and it seems to be carrying a child in its arms.
8242945.ch: 此人身影闪烁，随即没入枯木林中不见了踪迹，你恍惚瞥见它怀中似乎还抱着一个婴孩。

8242946.en: Halfway there, you suddenly feel a strong wind on your face. You look up to see a fierce Nether Demon standing on top of withered trees, with a ghostly sneer on its lips.
8242946.ch: 行至半途，你突然感到煞风扑面，抬头看去，只见一只凶恶的冥妖正站在枯木之上戏谑地看着你，嘴角还勾勒出一丝鬼魅般的冷笑。

8242947.en: Humans... like ants... no end in killing...

8242950.en: Betrayed our people... poisoned in secret... destroyed the weak... fled from battle...
8242950.ch: 背叛族类……暗下毒手……摧残弱者……临阵脱逃……

8242951.en: Their leader was such... the others... are they much better...?
8242951.ch: 头领如此……其他……还能如何……

8242955.en: Cultivation... is just... hunting and killing monsters... attacking their own... heh... heheh...
8242955.ch: 修行……无非……猎杀妖兽……残杀同胞……嘿……嘿嘿……

8242956.en: Twelve years ago... that person... what they did... you know full well...
8242956.ch: 二十年前……那个人……做了什么……你清楚……

8242959.en: You can... be buried... with the emperor...

8242961.en: Then I... will let you... live for two more days...

8242962.en: On... the battlefield... I'll take... your life... heh... heheh...
8242962.ch: 战场……之上……再取你……性命……嘿……嘿嘿……

8242963.en: There is a sinister gleam in the Nether Demon's eyes, then it turns and leaps away, disappearing into the shadows.
8242963.ch: 冥妖眼中阴冷的神色一闪而逝，随后转身一跃，消失于阴影之中。

8242964.en: The rogue had no intention to hurt me... I'd better leave first and make plans later.
8242964.ch: 此獠竟没有伤我之意……还是先行离开，再做打算。

8242965.en: You leave quickly, and that Nether Demon didn't chase you for some reason. However, you find that the sinister smile on its face has only deepened.
8242965.ch: 你飞身离开，那冥妖却不知为何没有追来，但你分明发现，它脸上渗人的笑意变得更加浓郁了。

8242966.en: Halfway there, you suddenly hear a strange human voice ahead. You send out your senses, and it seems there is a weak Qi being consumed by the Nether Air.
8242966.ch: 行至半途，你突然听闻前方隐有怪异人声，仔细感受下，似有一股衰弱的灵气正被冥气蚕食。

8242968.en: Who is... the humans'... current... leader...?

8242970.en: The mountain... defensive formation... How can it be broken?
8242970.ch: 山体……防御阵法……如何破解?

8242972.en: The city walls... guards... how many...?
8242972.ch: 城墙各门……守卫……数量……如何……？

8242974.en: Close by, a Nether Demon is using a Secret Technique to question a Cultivator Alliance Cultivator. That Cultivator is ashen-faced, and seems frightened out of their wits.
8242974.ch: 不远处，一个冥妖正使用秘法拷问一名仙盟修仙者，那修仙者面色惨白，似乎三魂七魄尽皆离体。

8242975.en: Haha... another one... who will die...

8242979.en: You think it over, and feel that it is not prudent to act rashly. It is best to retreat. While leaving, the Cultivator Alliance member's broken whisper echoes in your ears. You can only mourn silently for them.
8242979.ch: 思虑再三，你觉得贸然出手并非稳妥之计，还是暂时回避为好。离开的路上，那仙盟同僚失魂般的低语声犹在耳畔，你只能在心中默默为其哀悼。

8242980.en: Halfway there, there is a loud explosion ahead, and a great clash of spirit and Nether Air. A great power has been unleashed, and it seems as if Cultivators are fighting with Nether Demons.
8242980.ch: 行至半途，前方轰然炸响，强烈的灵冥二气冲撞湮灭，散发出惊人威势，似乎是有修仙者在与冥妖斗法。

8242981.en: Hmph! Spirits and monsters do not die easily!
8242981.ch: 哼，魑魅魍魉，还不速速受死！

8242982.en: Humans... encroach upon my boundaries... killed my people...
8242982.ch: 人类……犯我疆界……杀我族类……

8242983.en: Nonsense! You demons slaughter mortals and kill living beings! If it weren't for us, the Cultivator Alliance, the world would have been destroyed!
8242983.ch: 放屁！尔等妖孽屠杀凡人、残害生灵，若非我仙盟固守防线，八荒山海已然毁于一旦！

8242984.en: You have no shame still, waggling your tongue and preaching about right and wrong!
8242984.ch: 如今竟还不知廉耻，在此摇唇鼓舌、搬弄是非！

8242985.en: Ha... Haha... Humans... Like the emperor said... how pompous.
8242985.ch: 哈……哈哈……好个……人类……如王所言……冠冕堂皇……

8242986.en: Originally... the world... was the domain... of the demons... You people...
8242986.ch: 原本……八荒……乃……万妖之域……你们……

8242987.en: What irresponsible remarks! Cut the nonsense and fight!

8242989.en: Eliminating the Nether Demons and restoring the glory of the Cultivator Alliance is my duty!
8242989.ch: 铲除冥妖，重振仙盟荣光，乃我辈应尽义务！

8242990.en: Thank you for your help, Cultivator. Let us meet again.
8242990.ch: 多谢道友仗义相助，你我后会有期。

8242993.en: Of course... humans... good and evil... huh...

8242994.en: If we meet on the battlefield... there is no need... for mercy...

8242996.en: You think it over and feel that this is a lawless place where you should not linger, so you go around, avoiding the disturbance, and leave the sound of the explosion ringing in your ears.
8242996.ch: 思虑再三，你觉得此等是非之地不宜久留，于是便绕行而去，徒留耳边炸响声兀自回荡。

8242998.en: You hurry along in the dead of night, and suddenly hear a rasping human voice come from afar. It seems someone is secretly plotting something.
8242998.ch: 夜深人静，你匆匆赶路，突然听闻远处传来沙哑人声，似乎有人正暗中计划着什么。

8242999.en: Attack the city walls... and devour the humans!

8243000.en: The emperor's order... cannot be disobeyed...

8243001.en: Human leader... killed previous emperor... took captive...
8243001.ch: 人类头领……害死先王……掳走……

8243004.en: Start war... Wait for... my emperor's edict...
8243004.ch: 发动战争……等候……吾王圣谕……

8243006.en: You hurry along in the dead of night, and suddenly feel the ground tremble in the distance. An overwhelming black fog appears at the edge of your vision, and it seems an army of thousands is charging at you.
8243006.ch: 夜深人静，你匆匆赶路，突然间，远处地面微微震颤，你视野的尽头出现了铺天盖地的黑雾，似乎有千军万马在向你奔来。

8243007.en: You dare... attack... the emperor's army...

8243009.en: Nether Air does not stop... the waves of monsters do not end...

8243010.en: The city walls collapse... the formation destroyed...

8243011.en: Extinction of humans... Recovery of demons...

8243013.en: My emperor has given the order... there must be no delay...

8243014.en: The person's figure flickers, and disappears. The dark fog filling the sky instantly turns into black gas, and dissipates with that person.
8243014.ch: 此人身影闪烁，随即不见了踪迹，而那漫天黑雾也在瞬间化为黑气，跟随那人一同消散了。

8243015.en: You cannot see what the black fog in the distance is, but you feel the Nether Air in the sky, the fury. You act instantly and your body floats away, leaving this place.
8243015.ch: 远处黑雾飘忽不定，你未能看清其中究竟是何物，只觉冥气滔天，凶煞至极。你心念一动，身影便飘飞而去，离开了此地。

8243016.en: Aah... Ah! Help! There's... Cough... Ugh!
8243016.ch: 啊啊……啊！救命！有……有……咳咳……噗！

8243020.en: You see a Nether Demon devouring a Cultivator Alliance member from afar. Before you can get close, the Cultivator is killed by the Nether Demon.
8243020.ch: 你远远看到一个冥妖正在吞噬一名仙盟修仙者，未等你靠近，那名修仙者已被冥妖夺去了生命。

8243022.en: As the Cultivator is devoured, little by little, demonic patterns appear on the Nether Demon's body, and there seems to be a purple smoke coiling and billowing in its body.
8243022.ch: 随着修仙者被一点点吞噬殆尽，那冥妖的全身浮现出魔纹，体内隐有紫气流转翻腾。

8243024.en: Just as the Nether Demon reaches the Breakthrough Realm, it seems to notice your presence.
8243024.ch: 就在这冥妖突破境界之际，它似乎注意到了你的存在。

8243025.en: Hah... My emperor is number one... just nice... eat another one... fortify cultivation...
8243025.ch: 哼哼……吾王在上……正好……再吃一个……巩固修为……

8243027.en: The demonic patterns on the Nether Demon's body flicker with what seems like breathing, and the aura it emits grows ever stronger... But it seems to be concentrating on transforming energy, and is not interested in pursuing you for now. It will leave on its own before long.
8243027.ch: 那冥妖身上的魔纹如呼吸般闪烁，其散发的气场也不断增强……不过它似乎正专注于转化能量，暂时无心追击，不多时便自顾自离开了。

8243028.en: Halfway there, you suddenly feel a gust of wind from behind you, and you turn back instinctively to see that a gaping chasm seems to have opened up in the ground behind you. Thick Nether Air is spreading from the chasm.
8243028.ch: 行至半路，你突觉背后一阵阴风吹来，恍惚失神之间你下意识回过头去，却发现身后不远处的地面上似乎裂开了一条缝隙，股股浓郁的冥气正从缝隙中蔓延而出。

8243029.en: You walk to the chasm in a daze. A strange wisp of Nether Air burrows into your body at once.
8243029.ch: 你迷迷糊糊地走回裂缝边，一股奇异的冥气一下钻入了你的体内。

8243031.en: Given by the underworld... the orders...

8243033.en: Even if... fated to never... return home... no regrets... following my emperor...
8243033.ch: 纵使……注定永无……归巢之时……无怨无悔……跟从吾王……

8243034.en: I am willing... to be a pawn...

8243036.en: The image in the mind slowly dissipates, and the restlessness in the body disappears too. You open your eyes and a concentrated energy rushes out of your meridians. However, there is nothing in front of you, no chasm in the ground...
8243036.ch: 脑海中的影像缓缓散去，体内的躁动感也跟着消失，你睁开双眼，经脉中蓦然涌出一股浓厚灵力，可眼前却空空如也，哪里还有什么裂缝……

8243037.en: You think it over, and feel that this is not the right time to linger. You put your thoughts in order and leave swiftly. The next time you look back, the chasm in the ground seems to have never appeared. It was there, and then it was not.
8243037.ch: 思虑再三，你觉得此等是非之地不宜久留，于是便调理心神、飞身离去。可再度回望之时，那地上的裂缝却似从未出现一般，悄然消失了。

8243038.en: You're walking when you suddenly hear a series of explosions in the distance. Violent bursts of Nether Air quake towards you, like there is a powerful existence engaging in a life-and-death duel.
8243038.ch: 你正走着，忽然间只听得远方连环爆裂之声炸响，剧烈的冥气波动震荡开来，似乎有什么强大的存在正进行着生死决斗。

8243039.en: You advance quietly, and soon see two Nether Demons facing off against each other. Both have grievous wounds, and it is obvious that they had a fierce battle.
8243039.ch: 你向前悄然行进，不一会便看到两只冥妖正相互对峙，其身上各有伤痕，显然是经历过一番激战。

8243040.en: Traitor... emperor's orders... still... trying to leave...

8243041.en: Emperor's order... retake territory... you... willfully... kill humans...
8243041.ch: 王命……夺回领地……你……肆意……滥杀人类……

8243042.en: Evil people... devour evil... to strengthen... my people... you don't kill... then you will be killed!
8243042.ch: 奸邪之人……噬其恶念……方可……壮我族群……你不杀之……其便杀你！

8243043.en: He and I... live in peace... no crime...
8243043.ch: 他与我……和平相处……何罪之有……

8243049.en: But... battlefield... the enemy... no need... for mercy...
8243049.ch: 不过……战场……为敌……不必……留情……

8243050.en: After saying that, the Nether Demon leaves without looking back.
8243050.ch: 说完，这冥妖头也不回地离开了。

8243054.en: Battlefield... meet... decide again... life or death...

8243056.en: Violate... my tribe's taboo... must... die for sin...
8243056.ch: 触犯……我族禁忌……必当……以死谢罪……

8243059.en: You watch as the two Nether Demons start fighting again. Suddenly, one of the Nether Demons' expressions changes, and its movement slows.
8243059.ch: 眼看两个冥妖又要战在一处，突然，其中一只冥妖神情一闪，手上的动作也为之一缓。

8243063.en: One of the Nether Demons turns its head in a certain direction, ignoring the injuries it has sustained. It mumbles to itself, and drags its badly battered body in the opposite direction, trying to flee.
8243063.ch: 一只冥妖扭头看向某个方向，不顾身上受到的重创，口中喃喃自语，随后竟拖着重伤的残躯，朝相反的方向来踉跄逃离而去。

8243065.en: You think it over and feel that this is a lawless place where you should not linger, so you swiftly retreat and run away before the two Nether Demons notice you.
8243065.ch: 思虑再三，你觉得此等是非之地不宜久留，于是便趁那两只冥妖尚未发现之际，迅速退走离开。

8243067.en: You are walking when you suddenly feel unsettled. There seems to be a gaze focused on you, but the person looking at you doesn't seem to have any ill intent.
8243067.ch: 你正走着，突然感觉浑身不自在，似乎有一道目光一直紧紧落在你身上，但却对方好像没有半分敌意。

8243069.en: Your body... has... the smell of my kin...

8243071.en: How is this possible? What do you mean?
8243071.ch: 怎么可能？你究竟是何意？

8243073.en: Nether Air corruption? Do you mean the demon tribe led by Chief Feng Yunchuo?
8243073.ch: 冥气侵蚀？……莫非你说的是风允婼族长与其所率领的魔族？

8243074.en: Demon tribe? This manner of address... humans.. as expected...

8243075.en: Not all... of my kin... hates... humans...
8243075.ch: 并非所有……同族……都仇恨……人类……

8243076.en: Maybe... we are just... being used... submit to... the emperor...
8243076.ch: 或许……我们只是……被利用……屈服于……王……

8243077.en: I... go with you... take me to... see those... kin...
8243077.ch: 我……跟你走……带我去……见那些……同类……

8243080.en: You don't know why, but the blood of the Nether Demon in front of you suddenly glows, and it abruptly falls to the ground, limp and twitching. It seems to be undergoing great torture.
8243080.ch: 不知为何，眼前这冥妖身上突然血光大放，它一下子瘫软在地、浑身抽搐，似乎在经受严酷折磨。

8243082.en: A few moments later, the Nether Demon stops twitching. However, its eyes have become hollow and it seems like its spirit has been broken. After a short while, it wanders off on its own.
8243082.ch: 片刻后，冥妖停止了抽搐，但它的眼神却变得空洞无比，整个人失魂落魄，不一会儿便兀自走开了。

8243085.en: The Nether Demon cannot hide its disappointment. It gives you a deep look, then leaves quietly.
8243085.ch: 这冥妖难掩失落，深深凝望你一眼后悄然离去了。

8243086.en: Since it has no intention of harming me, there is no need to get too involved with this demon. It's best to leave.
8243086.ch: 既无意伤我，便也不必与此妖过多纠缠，还是离开为妙。

8243087.en: The Nether Demon sees you move far away but it does not follow you anymore. It hides quietly in the withered forest.
8243087.ch: 这冥妖见你远遁，便也不再跟随，悄然隐没在了周遭枯木之中。

8243105.en: Destroy the city walls... and devour the humans!

8243106.en: The emperor ordered... war... about to start...
8243106.ch: 吾王有命……战争……即将发动……

8243112.en: War is coming... my emperor has ordered... endure silently...
8243112.ch: 战争将至……吾王有命……隐忍……

8243114.en: You act immediately, and you instantly disappear. You cannot see what the black fog in the distance is, but you feel the Nether Air in the sky, the fury.
8243114.ch: 你心念一动，身影便瞬间消失在了原地。远处黑雾飘忽不定，你未能看清其中究竟是何物，只觉冥气滔天，凶煞至极。

8243115.en: Aaah... Ah! Help! Save... Save me! (Crack) Ah!
8243115.ch: 啊啊……啊！救命！……救……救我！（“咔吧”）啊！

8243120.en: Hmph... War is coming... Fortify cultivation...
8243120.ch: 哼哼……战争在即……巩固修为……

8243125.en: Little demon, do not make things up! I'll send your soul back to the underworld!
8243125.ch: 宵小妖物，搬弄是非，这就送你魂归冥界！

8243126.en: I knew it... Humans... are despicable...

8243127.en: Cultivator, if you are determined to eliminate demons, I will give this to you. I am sure you will be able to kill with it.
8243127.ch: 道友既有此等除魔卫道之心，在下便将此獠让与道友，想必道友必能将其斩杀。

8243128.en: I take the heads of mere demons easily. Why would I need to bother you to make a move too?
8243128.ch: 区区妖物，在下取其首级易如反掌，何需劳烦同道出手？

8243129.en: Cultivator, we have a duty to eliminate the demons. How about this, give me this demon, and you can return to the Cultivator Alliance to rest. The loot will be yours.
8243129.ch: 道友，除魔卫道乃我等分内之事，这样吧，此妖归我，道友还请回仙盟安歇，这些战利品便赠予你了。

8243130.en: You think it over and feel that this is a lawless place where you should not linger, so you go around, avoiding the disturbance.
8243130.ch: 思虑再三，你觉得此等是非之地不宜久留，于是便绕行而去。

8243132.en: While walking, you happen to discover the bones of several Nether Demons. Nether Air lingers around the bones, as if speaking of their unfulfilled desires.
8243132.ch: 行路之时，你无意间发现了几具冥妖的尸骨，其上冥气缭绕，似乎诉说着其未了的执念。

8243133.en: You slowly reach your hand into the Nether Air, probing. Strangely, the Nether Air seems to be avoiding your hand on purpose, and even split in two. You obtain a lot of loot from the bodies.
8243133.ch: 你缓缓将手探入冥气之中，可奇怪的是，那冥气像在刻意回避你的手，竟然向两边分开，你从尸体上收获了大量战利品。

8243134.en: You slowly reach your hand into the Nether Air, probing. The burning sensation comes, as expected, and you bear the pain to collect some loot.
8243134.ch: 你缓缓将手探入冥气之中，想象中的灼烧感传来，你顶着剧痛收集到了一些战利品。

8243135.en: You slowly reach your hand into the Nether Air, probing. An intense burning sensation consumes you instantly as you feel a wave of resentment crash into your spirit.
8243135.ch: 你缓缓将手探入冥气之中，强烈的灼烧感瞬间将你吞噬，你感到一股滔天怨念涌入你的精神。

8243137.en: While walking, you happen to discover a Nether Demon. It is still young, and seems to have been abandoned here due to the war.
8243137.ch: 行路之时，你无意间发现了一个冥妖，它还处于成长期，似乎是因为战乱而被遗弃在了这里。

8243138.en: You act immediately, and the Nether Demon is instantly pierced by your Tao. Although its wisdom has not been developed, humans and demons are enemies after all. If you let it mature, it will bring trouble to the Cultivator Alliance sooner or later...
8243138.ch: 你心念一动，那冥妖瞬间被你的道法洞穿。其虽灵智未开，但毕竟人妖相仇，若任其成长，早晚又是仙盟一大祸患……

8243139.en: You act immediately, and the Nether Demon is blasted away by your powerful coercion. It seems the demon will not survive. You discover a pile of things under its body. Although its wisdom has not been developed, humans and demons are enemies after all. If you let it mature, it will bring trouble to the Cultivator Alliance sooner or later...
8243139.ch: 你心念一动，那冥妖被你强大的威压生生震飞，眼见是活不成了，你发现它身下压着一摞东西。那幼崽虽灵智未开，但毕竟人妖相仇，若任其成长，早晚又是仙盟一大祸患……

8243140.en: You are about to make a move when the Nether Demon closes its eyes tightly, and a powerful wave of Nether Air bursts from its body. You are caught off guard, and feel a moment of dizziness. The power of the Nether Demon's self-destruction cannot be underestimated.
8243140.ch: 你刚准备动手，只见这冥妖紧闭的双眼突然圆睁，随后其体内爆发出一阵强烈的冥气波动。猝不及防之下，你感到一阵眩晕，冥妖自爆的威力果然不可小觑。

8243141.en: You act immediately, and a small formation appears around the Nether Demon, gradually concealing it...
8243141.ch: 你心念一动，一座小型阵法在那冥妖周身出现，逐渐将其隐蔽起来……

8243142.en: You pick this Nether Demon up and prepare to hide it. Just then, you discover a pile of things under it. They seem to have been left behind on purpose by someone...
8243142.ch: 你抱起了这只冥妖，准备将其藏匿起来，就在这时，你发现它身下压着一摞东西，似乎是某人刻意留下的……

8243143.en: You think it over, and are torn about what to do. In the end, you pretend not to have seen it, and walk around it.
8243143.ch: 你纠结再三，不知如何处理为好，于是便假装没看见，绕行而去。

8243198.en: Without permission, I'm afraid the Cultivator Alliance won't let us enter the city...
8243198.ch: 未经许可贸然出入，恐怕仙盟难以放行……

8243199.en: It's said that Cultivators are not allowed to climb over the city walls. If I need to enter or leave the city, I have to find another way.
8243199.ch: 据说仙盟之人不得私自翻越城墙，若意欲往返城墙内外，我还需另想办法。

8243200.en: These walls protect the city from waves of monsters. I'm afraid we can't enter and leave the city at will...
8243200.ch: 城墙乃是防范兽潮的重地，我恐怕难以随意进出……

8243201.en: Here are the ancient city walls of the Cultivator Alliance. Yet, a strange power inhibits me from climbing them...
8243201.ch: 此处虽是仙盟古城墙，却有一股奇异之力阻止我翻越……

8243202.en: Xingtian... What an overwhelming sense of oppression... We can't possibly resist his power if we haven't reached the Transcendent Realm...
8243202.ch: 刑天……好强的压迫感……若无登仙境界，恐怕难以抵挡这般威压……

8243203.en: The road ahead is filled with dense Nether Air. If we break into that place, I can't return here safe and sound. So, I have to rise to the Transcendent Realm first.
8243203.ch: 前方冥气浓稠至极，以我如今境界，若是进入则绝无生还可能，必须登仙之后再做打算。

8243204.en: What a strong power... Only those who are Transcendent can manage to resist it...
8243204.ch: 这股威能……只有登仙之人才能勉强抵挡一二……

8243205.en: The bright moon hangs in the sky, the color of the water. You see a man in the distance walking slowly towards the lake.
8243205.ch: 明月当空，月色如水，你看到远处有一男子正缓缓走向湖中。

8243208.en: In the faint moonlight, you see the vague outline of a man blowing a flute in the pavilion lying ahead.
8243208.ch: 晦暗的月光下，你隐约看到前方一亭子中，有一男子在吹笛。

8243209.en: Have you heard? That {name|B} challenged {name|A}, but {name|A} didn't dare to accept the challenge.
8243209.ch: 听说了吗？那{name|B}向{name|A}下战书，那{name|A}居然不敢接受挑战。

8243210.en: Yeah, what an embarrassment to {grade|A} cultivation. A mighty Heaven-chosen is actually so spineless. So what if they lose? That's better than not even having the guts to compete. It's not as if it's a life-and-death match either.
8243210.ch: 可不是，真丢{grade|A}修士的脸，堂堂天骄竟然如此没胆，纵然输了又如何，总好过比都不敢比，又不是生死之战。

8243211.en: Have you heard? That {name|B} challenged {name|A}, and {name|A} won.
8243211.ch: 听说了吗？那{name|B}向{name|A}下战书，最后是{name|A}胜出了。

8243213.en: You are strong indeed, Cultivator. I am content with my loss.
8243213.ch: 道友实力强悍，在下输得心服口服。

8243215.en: You are strong indeed, Cultivator. I am content.
8243215.ch: 这方才是道友的真正实力，在下心服口服。

8243216.en: Oh, it's you, {name|A}. What are you doing here?

8243225.en: I would love to be in the same Sect as you, and I look forward to working with you…
8243225.ch: 能和你在同一个宗门，我自是十分愿意的，那以后，还请多多指教……

8243226.en: You are walking along the road when you suddenly feel coercion coming from above your head so strong that it makes you unable to move.
8243226.ch: 正行走在路上的你，突然感觉头顶之上传来极强的威压，让你动弹不得。

8243227.en: You are struggling to raise your head, only to see two powerful cultivators squaring off with each other, but you can't tell their cultivation levels.
8243227.ch: 你艰难地抬起头，只见天空之上，竟有两名看不清修为的大能修士在对峙。

8243229.en: Humph, {name|B}, one of us shall die today.
8243229.ch: 哼，{name|B}，今日不是你死，便是我亡。

8243230.en: As the two stop speaking, a gust of wind swirls, the sky and earth turn gloomy, and a big fight is imminent.
8243230.ch: 随着两人的话音落下，顿时狂风骤起，天地变色，大战一触即发。

8243232.en: You're defeated by me. Admit that!
8243232.ch: 你也有败在我手下的一天！

8243235.en: No one will be able to save a person whose Immortal Soul has been shattered. I want you to feel the helplessness of watching yourself die without having the power to return to heaven! Hahaha!
8243235.ch: 元魂已碎之人，谁出手也救不活了，我要你好好感受，这种看着自己走向死亡，却无力回天的感觉！哈哈哈！

8243237.en: After laughing loudly, {name|C} ascends into the sky, leaving {name|B} behind.
8243237.ch: 一声大笑过后，{name|C}御空而去，留下{name|B}在原地。

8243240.en: You, little {grade|A} kid! My Immortal Soul has been shattered, but my cultivation did not disappear completely. Don't make me come drag you out myself!
8243240.ch: {grade|A}的小辈，虽然我元魂已碎，但修为没完全消失，莫不是要我亲自抓你出来！

8243242.en: Mentor, I just happened to be here and watching by. I bear no ill will…
8243242.ch: 前辈，晚辈只是偶然路过，故在一旁观战，并没有恶意……

8243243.en: You are just a {grade|A}. What can you do even if you do bear ill will? The perception of Transcendent cultivators is incredibly keen. You were already detected when you came near here.
8243243.ch: 你不过{grade|A}，便是真有恶意，又能如何？何况登仙修士的感知范围极广，你靠近的时候，就被察觉了。

8243245.en: Those under {grade|B} are like ants to him. Would you care about an ant?
8243245.ch: 对那人来说，不到{grade|B}，终是蝼蚁，你会在意蝼蚁的感受和想法吗？

8243249.en: I'm sure you've heard that though my Immortal Soul has been shattered, I still have a lot of cultivation remaining. If I transfer some of my original Energy and Insight to you, it will allow you to attain Breakthrough to {gradeV|1|A} immediately, and it will not affect your future cultivation. Will you accept this offer?
8243249.ch: 想必你也听到，我元魂已碎，但修为残存不少，若将些许本源灵力和感悟灌注于你，可让你直接突破到{gradeV|1|A}，并且不影响你未来的修行，你可愿意接受？

8243250.en: You agreed? Aren't you afraid I'm setting you up?
8243250.ch: 你就这么答应了，不怕我害你？

8243251.en: If that's the case, Mentor, you would have done it already.
8243251.ch: 若前辈想害我，早就可以动手了

8243252.en: Very good. Brave and cautious. Now I believe you can do that thing.
8243252.ch: 不错不错，胆大心细，如此我倒更是相信你能办到那件事了。

8243254.en: Mentor, I'm still in a low Realm, but I know very well that nothing comes free in this world.
8243254.ch: 前辈，晚辈虽然境界低，但还是知道一句话，这天下没有免费的午餐。

8243255.en: Smart boy, huh? Now I believe you can do that thing.
8243255.ch: 你小子心眼倒是多，如此我倒更是相信你能办到那件事了。

8243257.en: I bear no ill will in transferring my cultivation to you, but in exchange, I would like you to find me a {itemLink1011724} in fifty years. Would you do that?
8243257.ch: 我将修为传给你，并无恶意，但作为交换，我希望你在五十年内为我寻来一颗{itemLink1011724}，你可愿意接受？

8243258.en: This Elixir will allow me to achieve Body Reconstruction.
8243258.ch: 此丹药可以让我重塑肉身。

8243259.en: But he said your Immortal Soul is already shattered...
8243259.ch: 可那人不是说，前辈元魂已碎……

8243260.en: He was right. But Transcendent cultivators always have a fallback plan. I managed to get a Secret Technique in an ancient Mystic Realm and refine a second Immortal Soul.
8243260.ch: 那人没说错，但登仙之人，岂能没有后手。我早年在一处上古秘境之中得到一本秘法，炼出了第二元魂。

8243261.en: My first Immortal Soul was shattered when I fought with {name|C}, but I still keep a last breath of the second one, which is special and can last for fifty years without dissipating.
8243261.ch: 和那{name|C}一战，我只是第一元魂碎了，这第二元魂还保留着一丝，此元魂较为特殊，可以持续五十年不消散。

8243262.en: I see. So how do I get the Elixir?
8243262.ch: 原来如此，那此丹药如何获得？

8243263.en: You'll know after you achieve Reborn.
8243263.ch: 待你羽化之后，自会知道此物获得之法。

8243264.en: Reborn…But I'm only in {grade|A}. Why don't you ask your Reborn friends to help you out, Mentor…
8243264.ch: 羽化……我如今方才{grade|A}，前辈为何不直接让羽化好友前来相助……

8243265.en: Too late. The fight unexpected came up. And my newly refined second Immortal Soul is so weak that even my Divine Consciousness is incompatible with it. I will soon enter a state of complete stillness.
8243265.ch: 来不及了，此番交战本就在意料之外，再加上那第二元魂我初炼不久，非常微弱，连我的神识都负担不起，我很快就要进入彻底沉寂的状态。

8243266.en: Once that happens, no one other than the last person my Divine Consciousness remembers will be able to wake me up.
8243266.ch: 一旦彻底沉寂，非我神识最后记忆之人，都无法将我唤醒。

8243267.en: That means my second Immortal Soul is basically useless, although it can last fifty years. No one will be able to wake me up anyway. I might as well just die.
8243267.ch: 那我这第二元魂也无用了，无人可将我唤醒，纵然五十年也没有意义，不若一死。

8243268.en: So if I want to help you, Mentor, I'll have to achieve Reborn in fifty years, right?
8243268.ch: 所以我若要帮到前辈，便意味着我需要在五十年之内修炼至羽化之境？

8243269.en: Exactly. You are just in {grade|A} now, but you are such a gifted cultivator and blessed with an extraordinary Destiny. So it's not unthinkable for you to achieve Reborn in fifty years.
8243269.ch: 不错，虽然你现在方才{grade|A}，却是天生的修炼种子，身后气运更非常人可比，五十年内羽化，对你来说，并非不可能之事。

8243270.en: But what if I can't find this {itemLink1011724} for you in fifty years?
8243270.ch: 若我五十年内不能为前辈寻来这{itemLink1011724}呢？

8243271.en: Once a connection is established between men, there is karma, the spiritual principle of cause and effect. The higher one's Realm, the stronger the karma.
8243271.ch: 人与人之间，一旦建立联系，便是有了因果，境界越高，因果之力的影响便越强。

8243272.en: If you promise to help me, it will be the cause, and if you fail to deliver your promise, it will be the effect. I'm a Transcendent cultivator, so the aftermath of our karma will be felt by you once you become one.
8243272.ch: 今日你若应我这件事，这便是因，他日你若做不到这件事，那便是果。由于我乃登仙修士，这因果之劫恐也会应验在你登仙之后。

8243273.en: Everyone is different, and I can't tell you what exactly is going to happen to you. But remember, this is both an opportunity and a risk. Think carefully and I won't force you.
8243273.ch: 每个人都不相同，这我无法告知于你。总而言之，此事对你来说，是机遇与危险并存，你好好考虑一番，我不会强求。

8243274.en: I'm sorry, Mentor. I can't do this.

8243275.en: No matter. The unpredictable is fearsome. I understand that.
8243275.ch: 无妨，不可预估的事情本就令人害怕，这是人之常情。

8243276.en: It's destiny that brings us together. I'll give you this {getUnitProp|B}.
8243276.ch: 你我相遇一场，也算有缘，这{getUnitProp|B}便送你了。

8243279.en: I really appreciate it, Mentor. But I can't take it.
8243279.ch: 无功不受禄，前辈好意在下心领了。

8243280.ch: 你……罢了，既然你不想要，我也不勉强。

8243281.en: Cultivation is like a war against the heavens and men, and if you fail, you will die. That's your destiny.
8243281.ch: 修炼一途，本就是与天争，与人争，争不过便是身死道消，命数罢了。

8243282.en: Now it doesn't make any sense to have a second Immortal Soul.
8243282.ch: 既如此，这第二元魂也没有必要存在了。

8243283.en: As soon as the words leave his mouth, {name|B}'s body begins to shatter, and {gender1|B}'s face is calm as he waits for complete stillness to fall.
8243283.ch: 话音刚落，{name|B}的身体便开始渐渐破碎，{gender|B}面色平静，等待着彻底归于沉寂。

8243284.en: Raindrops keep falling. {name|B}, whose flesh has nearly dissipated, looks up at the rain that is passing through his body and utters one last word that echoes in your ears.
8243284.ch: 淅淅沥沥的雨丝从空中落下，肉身近乎消散的{name|B}看着头顶那穿过身体的雨滴，说出了最后一句话，回响在你耳旁。

8243285.en: Cultivator, look at this rain, born from the sky and dead on the land. Each drop sees a different facet of this world, and its journey in between is essentially the truth of life.
8243285.ch: 道友，你看这雨，由天而生，至地而死，每一滴雨看到的风景都不相同，这中间的过程，又何尝不是人生。

8243286.ch: 在下愿意接过这一份因果。

8243287.en: I was right about you. Time is running out. Now start receiving my original Energy.
8243287.ch: 我没看错你，时间不多了，现在便开始接受我的本源灵力吧。

8243288.ch: 咳咳，很好，一切都很顺利。

8243291.en: The world falls silent. {name|B} closes his eyes, as if he is lost in memories.
8243291.ch: 四方俱静，{name|B}眉眼低垂，似乎陷入了久远的回忆之中。

8243292.en: Do you know? I chose to be a Rogue Cultivator from the first day when I set foot on the Immortal Path, thinking that I would be freed from all kinds of sect rules without a worry in the world and I wouldn't have to do anything just because others expect me to. The world is vast and I'm the master of my own life.
8243292.ch: 你可知，从我踏入仙道第一天，我就选择了散修这条路，便是想着一个人自由自在，没有多余的牵挂，不被繁琐的门规束缚，不必因为在乎别人而委屈自己，世界广阔，随心所至。

8243293.en: But then I realized that freedom comes with a price. Without a sect and the protection of senior cultivators, I have to work many times harder than those sect disciples and the children of powerhouses to be stronger.
8243293.ch: 后来我发现，自由也是有代价的，没有宗门做后盾，没有高境界的修士庇护，我要不断向上修行，就要比那种宗门弟子，大能子女付出更多倍的努力才行。

8243294.en: All they have to do is finish Sect Missions and earn Sect Contribution, or just ask their parents for Heaven and Earth Treasures that I worked so hard to get.
8243294.ch: 他们只要按部就班地完成宗门任务赚取宗门贡献，或者主动跟父母索取，便可以得到我历经千辛万苦才拿到的天材地宝。

8243295.en: I doubted myself when I was repeatedly defeated by those Monsters. I thought if I hadn't insisted on being a Rogue Cultivator, I may not have had to suffer so much, and would instead have broken through faster, become stronger, and achieve more than I do now.
8243295.ch: 当我一遍又一遍从妖兽身前败退之时，也曾动摇，如果一开始我不这么倔强的坚持当散修，是不是就不用经历这么痛苦的一切，境界反而会突破得更快，实力也会更强，拥有的一切会比现在更多。

8243296.en: But now, as I'm about to die, I'm convinced that I made the right choice.
8243296.ch: 但如今，真的到了将死这一刻，我反而无比的坚定自己当初的选择是对的。

8243297.en: Looking back, my journey to be a cultivator is anything but conventional and boring. It's full of exciting ups and downs. Now with death looming large, I don't have any regrets.
8243297.ch: 回首望去，我的修仙之路没有庸庸碌碌，也没有千篇一律，足够丰富，也精彩万分，纵然真的面对死亡，我也不会有什么遗憾。

8243298.en: Maybe the only thing that amounts to regret is that I don't leave any tradition. All men want to leave something behind in this world after all.
8243298.ch: 若真要说有什么遗憾，便是我没有留下一道传承，人嘛，终究还是希望在这个世界可以留下一点东西。

8243299.en: {name|B} looks up at you. A glimmer of light is flickering in his once-dull eyes.
8243299.ch: {name|B}抬头望向你，原本暗淡的眼神出现了一丝光彩。

8243300.en: {name|A}, would you like to be my apprentice?

8243301.en: Yes, I want to be your apprentice. Esteemed Master, your apprentice {name|A} greets you.
8243301.ch: 在下愿意拜前辈为师，师父在上，请受徒弟{name|A}一拜。

8243302.en: Haha, God helps those who help themselves. I have a new apprentice now. Even if I fail to achieve Body Reconstruction, my life will be still worthwhile…
8243302.ch: 哈哈，老天待我不亏，让我在这一刻收到徒弟，就算以后重塑肉身失败，这辈子也算值了……

8243304.en: Now that I'm your Master, I don't want to confine you to karma anymore. That may hold back your cultivation.
8243304.ch: 你我既已为师徒，我也不愿再用那因果约束于你，影响你修行。

8243305.en: In cultivation, the faster you try to progress, the longer it seems to take you. You are a gifted kid. Just stay true to yourself and take your time to build a solid foundation, and then it's just a matter of time before you achieve Breakthrough.
8243305.ch: 修仙一途，欲速则不达，徒儿你本就天赋异禀，只需守住本心，一步一步地打好根基，突破便是水到渠成之事。

8243306.en: I don't have much with me that you can use. Take this {getUnitProp|B} as a gift.
8243306.ch: 我身上你能用的东西不多，这{getUnitProp|B}给你，就当为师给你的见面礼。

8243308.en: Don't think I'm stingy. I'm a Rogue Cultivator, and don't have treasures as valuable as those Sect masters have.
8243308.ch: 不要觉得师父小气，散修嘛，身上的宝贝没法和大宗门比。

8243310.en: Raindrops fall all of a sudden. {name|B}, whose flesh is nearly dissipated, looks up at the rain that is passing through his body and utters one last word that echoes in your ears.
8243310.ch: 淅淅沥沥的雨丝突然从空中落下，肉身近乎消散的{name|B}看着头顶那穿过身体的雨滴，说出了最后一句话，回响在你耳旁。

8243311.en: Kid, look at this rain, born from the sky and dead on the earth. Each drop sees a different facet of this world, and its journey in between is essentially the truth of life.
8243311.ch: 徒儿，你看这雨，由天而生，至地而死，每一滴雨看到的风景都不相同，这中间的过程，又何尝不是人生。

8243313.en: Mentor, I don't really want to follow a Master now. Sorry…
8243313.ch: 前辈，在下现在还不想拜师，抱歉……

8243314.en: No worries. Cough…I'm a dying man. Your promise is already good enough. I guess I'm asking too much.
8243314.ch: 无妨，咳咳，本就将死之人，能得你一诺，已然不错，是我要求太多了。

8243315.en: Take this {getUnitProp|B}. It will come in handy in your cultivation.
8243315.ch: 这{getUnitProp|B}给你，也算助你修行了。

8243323.en: I can't believe you made it. Thank you for saving my life.
8243323.ch: 真没想到你真的能做到，在此谢过道友了，救命之恩无以为报。

8243324.en: In retrospect, you would accomplish what you have now even without me. So it's fair to say that I've benefited a lot from you.
8243324.ch: 现在回想起来，纵然没有我，也不会影响道友的修行之路，算起来，还是我沾了道友的光。

8243325.en: You helped me a lot, Cultivator.

8243326.en: There is something I treasured a lot. Here, please do take this {getUnitProp|B} as a thank-you gift, my friend.
8243326.ch: 这{getUnitProp|B}是我身上的珍贵之物，送给道友聊表谢意，望莫要推辞。

8243328.en: Apprentice, it's been a long time.

8243330.en: I can't believe you made it. I'm so proud of you.
8243330.ch: 真没想到你真的能做到，为师为你感到自豪。

8243331.en: Thank you, Master, for your transference of Martial Arts and gifts.
8243331.ch: 这还要感谢师父当年的传功和赠礼。

8243332.en: I feel really bad about it. I didn't get to teach you anything, and I couldn't even protect you. Kid, you've been through a lot these years, right…
8243332.ch: 说到这，我这师父当得实在惭愧，没有来得及教授你一次，甚至都不能给你提供庇护，徒儿，你这些年过得很辛苦吧……

8243333.en: I know you're just trying to make me feel better. Now that you've come a long way in XII, I'm simply not able to teach you anything…
8243333.ch: 我知道，你不过是在安慰我罢了，如今，你早已在自己的大道上走得很远，我也不能教给你更多的东西了……

8243335.en: I'm so happy that you've survived the most difficult time on your own, found your XII and come a long way. I couldn't have done better than you.
8243335.ch: 你能自己挺过那段最困难的时间，找到了自己的大道，如今更是在这条大道上走了很远，我很欣慰，纵然是我，做得也不能比你更好。

8243337.en: The {getUnitProp|B} I owned is valuable. Now you can have it.
8243337.ch: 这{getUnitProp|B}是我身上一些珍贵之物，如今便交给你。

8243339.en: This no longer interests me. I've been having the Last Breath all these years, and my Divine Consciousness has been sinking into infinite darkness and helplessness, not knowing where to go.
8243339.ch: 我对这个已经没兴趣了，一丝元魂这些年，我的神识在无边黑暗中沉寂，不知方向，不见光明。

8243340.en: After I returned from my Body Reconstruction, I was as happy as I was doubtful: What's the point of all these years of cultivation when I'm still doomed to die as a Transcendent cultivator?
8243340.ch: 重塑肉身归来后，我既高兴，却也产生了浓浓的疑惑，修行这么多年，纵然登仙也避免不了一死，那修仙到底为了什么？

8243341.en: I would like to travel around and find the answer.
8243341.ch: 我打算四处游历一番，找到自己的答案。

82433421.en: This is the embryonic soul I obtained before. It still needs some time to develop, and after it grows into a full one, it could protect you in critical conditions.
82433421.ch: 这是我当年获得的元魂胚胎，需温养些许时日，介时可在危难之中护你周全。

8243343.en: Your mind is a mess, and that's why you can't have inner peace during cultivation. Your Divine Consciousness is attacked unexpectedly when you're about to calm down and examine your mind.
8243343.ch: 你近日感觉思绪杂乱，修行总是无法入定，你正打算沉入心神检查一番之时，神识突然遭受到了攻击

8243344.en: So this is probably the Transcendent tribulation the person who transferred Martial Arts to me was talking about…
8243344.ch: 看来这便是当初给我传功那人所说的登仙之劫……

8243367.en: You take out an Elixir and force this person to eat it.
8243367.ch: 你拿出了一枚丹药，强迫此人吃下。

8243371.en: You! What did you…(Cough)…no…put in my mouth…(Barf)
8243371.ch: 你！你喂我……咳咳……噗……吃了什……呕！

8243373.en: This person takes out an Elixir and forces you to eat it.
8243373.ch: 此人拿出了一枚丹药，强迫你吃下。

8250001.en: As you open the manual to start your studies, boom! Light dances along the spine, and a woman appears.
8250001.ch: 你翻开秘籍进行参研，没料面前书脊处灵光聚合，一个女子的倩影骤然出现。

8250002.en: Well, well. Not bad, you little goofball. Let me give you a hand.
8250002.ch: 小笨蛋，悟性不错啊？我来帮帮你吧。

8250003.en: The woman touches your forehead with her fan, and a jolt of energy shoots up your spine. Knowledge floods your mind, as if the manual's secrets have been whispered directly into your ear.
8250003.ch: 面前灵体手持折扇朝你额心一点，一股力量自你小腹升起灌顶而上，同时眼前女灵体开始对你口传心授。只眨眼间你似乎领悟了当前秘籍的大部分内容。

8250004.en: Wake up, little goofball. I need your help.
8250004.ch: 小笨蛋，醒醒，看。姐姐有事要你帮忙。

8250005.en: She points, and a pack of monsters charges...
8250005.ch: 那女灵伸指一点，只见面前若干妖兽在远处朝你猛扑而来……

8250006.en: Not bad, you faced them down, you little goofball. You're learning fast.
8250006.ch: 小笨蛋，东西领悟得不错。轻而易举就击退了这些怪物。

8250007.en: Want to know who I am, you little goofball? Well, that'll cost you.
8250007.ch: 小笨蛋，要知道我是谁，那可是要付出代价的。

8250008.en: But if you want to see me again, <r>just keep reading those manuals</r>.
8250008.ch: 不过若想找姐姐聊天，不妨<r>多读几本秘籍</r>，呵呵。

8250009.en: The world's a dangerous place. If you want to make a real difference, you've got to work hard. Farewell.
8250009.ch: 八荒险恶，想要做一番惊天动地的事业还需努力修炼才是，呵呵，就此别过。

8250010.en: (<r>Keep reading those manuals</r>... What could she possibly mean by that?)

8250011.en: Listen, the world's a dangerous place, you little goofball. If you want to make a real difference, you've got to work hard and <r>keep reading those manuals</r>. Farewell.
8250011.ch: 小笨蛋，八荒险恶，想要做一番惊天动地的事业还需努力修炼<r>多读几本秘籍</r>才是，呵呵，就此别过。

8250012.en: As you open the manual to start your studies, boom! A burst of light explodes from its spine, gently swirling into a woman.
8250012.ch: 你翻开秘籍进行参研，书脊处突然灵光大盛，一股烟气缓缓聚拢，化作人形。

8250013.en: Well, well, you actually came looking for me, little goofball? Let's get you up to speed on this manual first, then we can talk.
8250013.ch: 小笨蛋，真来找姐姐啊？我先帮你融会贯通这本秘籍，接着咱们再好好说话。
